target.pattern: \bcarry (?:me|you|him|her|us|them|the pupils|her children) well through life\b|\bcarr(?:ies|ied|ying) (?:me|you|him|her|us|them|the pupils|her children) well through life\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A healthy body can carry them well through life.

brief.meaningEn: Provide lasting support as someone faces life over many years.
brief.meaningZh: 在人生多年不同經歷中，提供長久支撐。
brief.grammar: skills/qualities can carry someone well through life; carry/carries/carried/carrying; person is the supported object, not the thing being physically transported
brief.boundaryZh: 是長久支持的意象，不保證人生順利或每次成功；需有具體能長久有用的特質。
brief.misconceptionZh: 是長久支持的意象，不保證人生順利或每次成功；需有具體能長久有用的特質。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「長久支持人生路」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The source uses a healthy body as support. The productive carrying metaphor can also describe lasting skills or qualities; no claim that the whole wording is a fixed idiom or a medical guarantee.

listening.en: The teacher hoped that learning to ask for help and listen carefully would carry the pupils well through life, not merely help them pass the next test.
listening.zh: 老師希望學會求助及仔細聆聽，會長久支持學生人生，而不只是幫他們過下次測驗。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 老師重視可長久支撐學生的能力，不只短期考試。
老師認為求助能力只適用於下次測驗。
學生已完成多年工作，老師在報告他們的結果。
老師主要按學生下次測驗的分數，判斷求助及聆聽的價值。

listening.explanationZh: through life 與 not merely 明說長久用途，不是只按下次測驗評價；hoped 也不是已量度日後結果。

reply.promptEn: Why did the teacher value asking for help and listening?
reply.promptZh: 老師為甚麼重視求助及聆聽？

options.en: She hoped those skills would carry them well through life.
options.zh: 她希望那些能力會長久支持他們的人生。

options.en: She saw value in them beyond the next test.
options.zh: 她看見它們在下次測驗以外的價值。

options.en: They could help pupils respond to many later situations.
options.zh: 它們可幫學生回應日後不同情況。

options.en: Her aim was lasting support, not just a short-term examination result.
options.zh: 她的目標是長久支持，不只是短期考試結果。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學徒從師傅學會先問清楚、耐心檢查；他希望這態度在之後不同工作仍有用，沒有說保證每次成功。哪句貼切？

options.en: He hopes those habits will carry him well through life.
options.zh: 他希望那些習慣會長久支持他的人生。

options.en: He expects those habits to matter only until this apprenticeship ends.
options.zh: 他預期那些習慣只在學徒期結束前有用。

options.en: He is describing results already measured throughout his whole career.
options.zh: 他在描述整個事業已量度的結果。

scene.explanationZh: 希望態度長久有用，不是限於當期或已量度整段未來。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 carry them well through life 得出？

options.en: 某特質可在人生不同階段提供支撐。
有了這特質，今後遇到的困難就不需要另求協助。
需交代是甚麼特質支持哪些人。

contrast.explanationZh: 長久支撐並不取消後來的新需要或求助。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「老師只想下次測驗分數好吧？」但老師特別提到日後生活。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: She hopes the skills will carry them well through life, so her purpose reaches beyond this test.
options.zh: 她希望能力長久支持學生人生，所以目的不只這測驗。

options.en: We should treat the later-life comment as another name for the next test result.
options.zh: 應把日後生活的話當下次測驗結果的另一名稱。

options.en: Judge those skills only by the next test result, rather than consider how pupils might use them later.
options.zh: 只按下次測驗分數評那些能力，不考慮學生日後怎用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 老師重視日後不同經歷的用途，不把一生縮成下次測驗分數。

speaking.en: The patience she learned could carry her well through life, even when a new situation required more advice.
speaking.zh: 她學到的耐心可長久支持人生，即使新情況仍需更多意見。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留長久支持與仍可求助的分別。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友快畢業，擔心自己的作品不夠亮眼；你想在賀卡珍惜他願承認不知道、再主動學習的態度，祝它在人生日後不同經歷有用，不保證他一定得到某職位。用一至兩句英文祝福。

examples.en: Your willingness to admit what you do not know and keep learning could carry you well through life. I hope you keep that openness when you meet new challenges.
examples.zh: 你願承認不知道並繼續學習，這態度可長久支持人生。希望遇上新挑戰時，你仍保留那份開放。

examples.en: The thoughtful way you learn can carry you well through life, far beyond this graduation. I value that quality as much as the work on display.
examples.zh: 你用心學習的方式可長久支持人生，遠超這次畢業。我珍惜那特質，也珍惜展示的作品。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用具體學習態度作長久祝福，保留 could/can 的可能，不把支持當任何職位或未來結果已定。

takeaways.en: The practical judgement he developed could carry him well through life, though he would still have much to learn.
takeaways.zh: 他培養的實際判斷力可長久支持人生，儘管仍有很多需學。

takeaways.en: She hoped that curiosity would carry her children well through life, helping them ask useful questions.
takeaways.zh: 她希望好奇心會長久支持孩子人生，幫他們問有用問題。

sources.sentence: Swimming twice a week can build stamina.

brief.meaningEn: Develop the ability to sustain an activity for longer without becoming tired.
brief.meaningZh: 培養較長時間持續活動而不易疲累的能力。
brief.grammar: build stamina; builds/building/built; stamina concerns sustained effort, not merely a single fast action
brief.boundaryZh: 需有持續活動的能力線索，不只速度、名次或願望；本課人物經驗不提供通用訓練處方。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需有持續活動的能力線索，不只速度、名次或願望；本課人物經驗不提供通用訓練處方。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「培養持續活動的耐力」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: In the story, Nora wanted to build stamina for the walking club’s longer outings; she could manage the opening stretch comfortably but tired before the group’s usual turning point.
listening.zh: 故事中，諾拉想培養耐力應付步行會較長活動；起初一段尚能輕鬆應付，但在大隊慣常折返點前已累。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 她想改善較長時間持續步行的能力。
她主要想在起步幾秒走得比其他人快。
她已能輕鬆完成大隊所有較長路線。
她主要想認清路線及地標，而不是改善持續步行能力。

listening.explanationZh: tired before turning point 指較長活動中的持續能力，而非起步速度、認路或已達成。

reply.promptEn: What did Nora want to improve for the longer outings?
reply.promptZh: 諾拉想為較長活動改善甚麼？

options.en: She wanted to build stamina so she could keep going for longer.
options.zh: 她想培養耐力，讓自己可持續更久。

options.en: She hoped to sustain the effort beyond the opening stretch.
options.zh: 她希望能在起初一段之後仍維持活動。

options.en: Her concern was getting tired before the usual turning point.
options.zh: 她關心慣常折返點前已疲累。

options.en: She wanted more endurance for the longer walk, rather than a faster start.
options.zh: 她想要較長步行的耐力，而非更快起步。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物唱短段尚能從容，連續唱到較長段落卻漸疲倦；她問老師怎樣培養持續演唱的能力，沒有談高音或比賽名次。哪句貼切？

options.en: She wants to build stamina for the longer passages.
options.zh: 她想為較長段落培養耐力。

options.en: Her main goal is to reach a higher note in one brief phrase.
options.zh: 她主要目標是在一小句唱到較高音。

options.en: The account says she has already completed a long performance without tiring.
options.zh: 敘述說她已完成長演出而不累。

scene.explanationZh: 線索是持續到長段的能力，未給音高目標或已完成結果。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 build stamina？

options.en: 逐漸能較長時間維持一項活動。
只記錄一次起步加快，沒有持續能力的資料。
目標關乎減少長時間活動中途疲累。

contrast.explanationZh: 單次速度並不確立持續活動能力有所培養。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她起步比上次快，就表示已能走完全段吧？」記錄只提起初幾秒。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: A quicker start does not show whether she has built stamina for the rest of the outing.
options.zh: 起步較快，不顯示她是否已培養耐力應付餘下活動。

options.en: Use the faster opening seconds as the result for the whole outing.
options.zh: 把較快的起初幾秒當整段活動結果。

options.en: Compare only her starting position with the others rather than how long she can continue.
options.zh: 只比她與別人起步位置，不看可持續多久。

dialogue.explanationZh: 要看持續多久，不能用起步速度或位置代替。

speaking.en: She wanted to build stamina for longer activities, not simply make the first few seconds faster.
speaking.zh: 她想為較長活動培養耐力，不只是讓起初幾秒更快。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清耐力與起步速度。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：故事人物想參與需要長時間站着交談的展覽接待，但以前只做短時段。他要向統籌坦白希望逐漸培養耐力，先問可否有較短當值及休息安排，不承諾立即應付整天。用一至兩句英文代寫請求。

examples.en: I would like to build stamina for longer reception shifts, but I have only done short ones so far. Could we discuss a shorter first shift and suitable breaks?
examples.zh: 我想培養耐力應付較長接待當值，但目前只做過短時段。可否談較短的首次當值及合適休息？

examples.en: My aim is to build stamina for the exhibition work rather than promise a full day immediately. Please let me know whether we can agree a gradual start.
examples.zh: 我的目標是培養展覽工作的耐力，而非立即承諾整天。請告訴我可否議定逐步開始。

writing.selfCheckZh: 坦白現有經驗與持續能力目標，提出需協商的當值安排，不把願望寫成已能全日完成。

takeaways.en: The character hoped to build stamina for the longer rehearsals, rather than rush through the opening exercise.
takeaways.zh: 角色希望培養較長排練所需耐力，而非匆匆做完開場練習。

takeaways.en: Building stamina was her goal, but the short trial did not yet show how long she could continue.
takeaways.zh: 培養耐力是她的目標，但短試行仍未顯示她能持續多久。

sources.sentence: A short game helps students blow off steam.

brief.meaningEn: Do or say something that releases strong feelings or pent-up energy.
brief.meaningZh: 透過活動或說話，紓解強烈或積壓的情緒、精力。
brief.grammar: blow off steam; blow off some steam; blew/has blown; does not by itself mean angrily attacking someone
brief.boundaryZh: 紓解感受不等於原問題已解，也不要求發脾氣傷人；可看活動或談話怎樣讓人舒緩。
brief.misconceptionZh: 紓解感受不等於原問題已解，也不要求發脾氣傷人；可看活動或談話怎樣讓人舒緩。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「紓解積壓情緒或精力」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: After the tense planning meeting, we played a short informal game to blow off steam; I felt less wound up afterwards, although the disputed schedule still needed another discussion.
listening.zh: 緊張籌備會後，我們玩短時間的非正式遊戲紓解情緒；之後我沒那麼繃緊，儘管有爭議時間表仍需再談。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 活動讓說話者較舒緩，但時間表分歧仍在。
遊戲已使各方同意最後時間表。
說話者離開會議後仍未參與任何活動。
遊戲的主要目的是正式選出新籌備主席。

listening.explanationZh: less wound up 是情緒紓解，although 保留未解分歧，不是遊戲作正式決策。

reply.promptEn: Why did you play the short game after the meeting?
reply.promptZh: 會後為甚麼玩短遊戲？

options.en: We wanted to blow off steam after the tense discussion.
options.zh: 緊張討論後，我們想紓解情緒。

options.en: We needed a way to release some of the pent-up energy.
options.zh: 我們需找方法釋放一點積壓精力。

options.en: The activity helped us feel less wound up before returning to the issue.
options.zh: 回到問題前，活動幫我們沒那麼繃緊。

options.en: It was a break from the tension, not a vote on the schedule.
options.zh: 那是暫離緊張，不是對時間表投票。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物考試後仍覺緊繃，與朋友跳幾首熟悉歌曲後心情鬆了一點；成績尚未公布。哪句貼切？

options.en: They danced for a while to blow off steam after the exams.
options.zh: 考試後，他們跳了一會舞紓解情緒。

options.en: They danced before the exams as part of getting into a focused mood for the test.
options.zh: 他們在考試前跳舞，作為準備專注應考的方法。

options.en: They were rehearsing a graded dance performance rather than taking a relaxed break.
options.zh: 他們在排練計分舞蹈表演，而非輕鬆休息。

scene.explanationZh: 考試後緊繃及跳後鬆一點，支持紓解；不是考前專注準備或計分表演排練。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 blow off steam 得出？

options.en: 紓解強烈感受或積壓精力。
紓解後，導致情緒的實際分歧就已獲解決。
可透過談話或活動，不一定攻擊別人。

contrast.explanationZh: 感受舒緩並不確立原問題結果。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「你遊戲後平靜些，是否就不用再談那時間表？」分歧仍未議定。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: It helped us blow off steam, but we still need a practical discussion of the schedule.
options.zh: 它幫我們紓解情緒，但仍需實際討論時間表。

options.en: Use how relaxed we feel now as the agreement on the disputed times.
options.zh: 把我們現在多放鬆，當爭議時間已議定。

options.en: Hold another game in place of asking which times each group can use.
options.zh: 用再玩一場代替問各組可用時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可先舒緩再處理實際需要，不以情緒狀態或活動代協商。

speaking.en: Talking with a friend helped me blow off steam, even though I still had to decide what to do next.
speaking.zh: 與朋友談話幫我紓解情緒，儘管仍需決定下一步。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清情緒紓解與問題解決。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你因收到一封令人沮喪的評語，想先找朋友談幾分鐘，不是要他立即替你回信。你要禮貌問他是否有空聽，說明只是想紓解情緒，之後自己再整理回覆。用一至兩句英文發訊息。

examples.en: Do you have a few minutes to listen while I blow off steam about that discouraging feedback? I am not asking you to write my reply; I just need to talk before I organise my thoughts.
examples.zh: 你有幾分鐘聽我說那沮喪評語、讓我紓解情緒嗎？我不是要你代寫回信，只想先談，再整理想法。

examples.en: I would like to blow off some steam before deciding how to respond to the feedback. Could I talk it through with you when you have time?
examples.zh: 決定怎回評語前，我想先紓解一下情緒。你有空時，我可跟你談一談嗎？

writing.selfCheckZh: 先詢問朋友有否空，清楚分開傾訴紓解與代做回覆，不把紓解當評語問題已解或要求朋友受責罵。

takeaways.en: She went for a casual game with friends to blow off steam after a frustrating afternoon.
takeaways.zh: 令人沮喪的下午後，她跟朋友隨意玩遊戲紓解情緒。

takeaways.en: He blew off some steam by talking about the rehearsal, then returned to planning his response.
takeaways.zh: 他談排練紓解了一點情緒，再回去計劃怎樣回應。

lessons.titleZh: 走出課室，到外面學習或活動

target.pattern: \bget(?:s|ting)? out of the classroom\b|\bgot(?:ten)? out of the classroom\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Sports day lets students get out of the classroom.

brief.meaningEn: Leave the classroom to take part in learning or activity elsewhere.
brief.meaningZh: 離開課室，到別處參與學習或活動。
brief.grammar: get out of the classroom to + activity; got out; literal place departure in this context, not an idiom meaning stop learning
brief.boundaryZh: 離開課室不等於逃課、不學習或結束整天課程；需看去處及活動安排。
brief.misconceptionZh: 離開課室不等於逃課、不學習或結束整天課程；需看去處及活動安排。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「走出課室，到外面學習或活動」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Get out of a place describes departure. This classroom application is literal movement with contextual educational purpose, not a fixed figurative idiom.

listening.en: The local-history visit let us get out of the classroom and compare the old street plan with the buildings themselves; afterwards we returned to write up what we had noticed.
listening.zh: 本地歷史參觀讓我們走出課室，把舊街道圖與實際建築比較；之後回來整理所見。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 學生到實地比較資料，之後仍有課堂整理。
學生離開後已結束本周所有學習工作。
參觀只在課室用照片進行，沒到實地。
學生未獲安排，私自離開來避過歷史課。

listening.explanationZh: 實地比較與返回整理交代學習流程，不是逃課或只看片。

reply.promptEn: What was useful about leaving the classroom for the visit?
reply.promptZh: 這次走出課室參觀有甚麼用？

options.en: We could get out of the classroom and compare the plan with the actual street.
options.zh: 我們可走出課室，把圖與實際街道比較。

options.en: We saw the buildings that the old plan referred to.
options.zh: 我們看見舊圖所指的建築。

options.en: The visit gave us direct observations to write about afterwards.
options.zh: 參觀讓我們有直接觀察，之後可寫。

options.en: It connected the classroom material with a real place.
options.zh: 它把課堂材料與真實地方連起來。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 科學老師帶學生到校園池邊記錄所見昆蟲，之後回課室比較筆記；你想說離開課室做實地學習。哪句貼切？

options.en: The activity helps them get out of the classroom and make observations at the pond.
options.zh: 活動幫他們走出課室，在池邊觀察。

options.en: They finish their learning as soon as they leave the classroom door.
options.zh: 他們一離開課室門，就完成所有學習。

options.en: They make all their observations from pond pictures without leaving their seats.
options.zh: 他們沒離座，只從池塘圖片作全部觀察。

scene.explanationZh: 池邊記錄及回來比較仍是學習，不是結束或只看圖片。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 get out of the classroom 得出？

options.en: 離開課室到別處活動。
當事人一定在逃避課程或拒絕學習。
需看情境才知道活動是否屬課程安排。

contrast.explanationZh: 地方改變不確立逃避動機。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「不在課室，就沒在上歷史課吧？」你們正在實地比對舊圖。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: We can get out of the classroom and still learn; comparing the plan with the street is part of the task.
options.zh: 我們可走出課室而仍學習；把圖與街道比較是任務一部分。

options.en: Only the notes written before the visit can count as history learning.
options.zh: 只有參觀前寫的筆記可算歷史學習。

options.en: We should replace the comparison task with free time because the lesson cannot continue outside.
options.zh: 因課程不能在外繼續，應用自由時間取代比較任務。

dialogue.explanationZh: 課程目的及任務可延續到實地，不單由房間位置決定。

speaking.en: The visit gave us a chance to get out of the classroom and test our observations against a real place.
speaking.zh: 參觀讓我們有機會走出課室，在真實地方檢驗觀察。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清離開地方與停止學習。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區中心借地方讓你們英語班與願意參與的居民短談日常用語，你想寫謝卡，說這次走出課室讓你聽到不同說法，也感謝職員安排談話位置。你希望日後有機會再來，但仍需對方同意。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Thank you for helping us get out of the classroom and talk with residents about everyday expressions. We appreciated the conversation space, and we would welcome another visit if it suits the centre.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我們走出課室，與居民談日常說法。我們珍惜談話空間，若合中心安排，也希望有機會再訪。

examples.en: We were glad to get out of the classroom and hear different ways people use the language. Thank you for arranging the tables and introductions; may we ask about another session later?
examples.zh: 我們很高興走出課室，聽大家用語的不同方式。謝謝你安排桌位及介紹；日後可再問另一場嗎？

writing.selfCheckZh: 以實際談話及職員安排致謝，說明課室以外仍有語言學習，保留再訪需問許可，不把外出寫成逃課。

takeaways.en: The project helped the class get out of the classroom to hear how local people used the language.
takeaways.zh: 項目幫全班走出課室，聽本地人怎用語言。

takeaways.en: They got out of the classroom for the interview, then returned to compare what each group had heard.
takeaways.zh: 他們離開課室做訪問，再回來比較各組聽到的內容。

lessons.titleEn: squeezed to the edges of the timetable

target.pattern: (?:\bsqueezed to the edges of the timetable\b)|(?:\bsqueezed to the edges of a busy schedule\b)

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: At exam time, PE gets squeezed to the edges of the timetable.
sources.expression: squeezed to the edges of the timetable

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 87, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Art can be squeezed to the edges of a busy schedule.

brief.meaningEn: Given very little or peripheral scheduled time because other demands take priority.
brief.meaningZh: 其他需要佔優先，令某活動只剩少量或邊緣時段。
brief.grammar: be squeezed to the edges of the timetable / a busy schedule; the image means given only peripheral time or attention, not literally compressed paper.
brief.boundaryZh: 不必完全取消，也不是實際移動紙張；需指出時段縮減或只餘零碎安排，不從重要性直接推已恢復。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不必完全取消，也不是實際移動紙張；需指出時段縮減或只餘零碎安排，不從重要性直接推已恢復。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「被擠到時間表邊緣」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: As extra exam sessions were added, the school play was squeezed to the edges of the timetable: the cast had only brief gaps to rehearse, although the performance had not been cancelled.
listening.zh: 加了額外考試課後，校劇被擠到時間表邊緣：演員只餘短空檔排練，儘管演出沒取消。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 排練時段被其他課擠壓，只剩短空檔。
校劇已正式取消，所以不再有演出。
新增課主要擴充排練，演員有更多完整時段。
時間表維持原樣，演員只在選劇本。

listening.explanationZh: only brief gaps 指排練被擠壓，although 保留未取消，不是更多時間。

reply.promptEn: Why was the cast finding it hard to rehearse together?
reply.promptZh: 演員為甚麼難以一起排練？

options.en: The play was squeezed to the edges of the timetable by the extra sessions.
options.zh: 額外課令校劇被擠到時間表邊緣。

options.en: They had only short gaps left for rehearsals.
options.zh: 他們只餘短空檔排練。

options.en: Other scheduled demands had taken the longer shared periods.
options.zh: 其他已排需要佔去較長共同時段。

options.en: The performance remained planned, but rehearsal time had become fragmented.
options.zh: 演出仍有計劃，但排練時間變零碎。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 社區中心加開多項主要課程後，原本每周一小時的語言交流只剩前後各十分鐘，仍未停辦。哪句貼切？

options.en: The exchange has been squeezed to the edges of the timetable.
options.zh: 交流活動被擠到時間表邊緣。

options.en: The exchange now has a longer uninterrupted period than before.
options.zh: 交流現有比以前更長、不中斷時段。

options.en: The centre has removed the exchange from its programme altogether.
options.zh: 中心已把交流從節目完全移除。

scene.explanationZh: 原整段變短零碎符合擠到邊緣，未說完全停辦。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 squeezed to the edges of the timetable？

options.en: 其他活動佔優先，某項只餘短零碎時段。
某活動仍有完整固定時段，只把內容題目換新。
活動未取消，但獲分配時間明顯受壓。

contrast.explanationZh: 只改內容而完整時段不變，並非時段被擠壓。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「演出還在，就代表排練時間沒少吧？」但大家只剩短空檔。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: It has not been cancelled, but it has been squeezed to the edges of the timetable and needs a usable rehearsal slot.
options.zh: 它沒取消，但已被擠到時間表邊緣，需要可用排練時段。

options.en: Keep treating the original rehearsal period as available because the performance is still listed.
options.zh: 因演出仍列着，就繼續當原排練時段可用。

options.en: Spend the next meeting choosing costumes before checking whether the cast can share any rehearsal time.
options.zh: 未查演員有否共同排練時間，下次會議先選服裝。

dialogue.explanationZh: 仍有演出不代表排練時段如前；需核可用時間，不只看活動有列名。

speaking.en: The discussion was squeezed to the edges of the timetable, leaving only a few minutes for questions.
speaking.zh: 討論被擠到時間表邊緣，只餘幾分鐘提問。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說被擠壓的具體時段。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：上次工作坊的提問被擠到散場前，這次主辦者把重複示範縮短，恢復十分鐘問答，讓學員談自己試做時卡住之處。你想在會後致謝，具體肯定改動及結果，不說以後每次都已安排好。用一至兩句英文寫回饋。

examples.en: Last time, questions were squeezed to the edges of the timetable, so I appreciated the ten-minute discussion today. Thank you for making room for us to ask about the parts we could not yet do.
examples.zh: 上次提問被擠到時間表邊緣，所以我珍惜今天十分鐘討論。謝謝你留空間讓我們問仍未做到的部分。

examples.en: Our questions had been squeezed to the edges of the timetable, but shortening the repeated demonstration gave them a real place today. The chance to discuss our own attempts made the session more useful to me.
examples.zh: 我們的問題原被擠到時間表邊緣，但縮短重複示範，今天給了它們真正位置。能談自己的嘗試，令這場對我更有用。

writing.selfCheckZh: 先交代過去被擠壓，再感謝今天具體恢復時段及討論機會，不把舊狀態誤寫成今天仍完全一樣。

takeaways.en: The art club was squeezed to the edges of the timetable when extra meetings filled its usual slot.
takeaways.zh: 額外會議佔原時段後，美術社被擠到時間表邊緣。

takeaways.en: Painting is squeezed to the edges of a busy schedule when revision fills every afternoon.
takeaways.zh: 當每個下午都用來溫習，繪畫便在繁忙日程中被擠到邊緣。

sources.sentence: Students can feel buried in homework.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 25, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: By Sunday evening, she felt buried under chores.

brief.meaningEn: Feel overwhelmed by a large pile of duties, whether school homework or household chores.
brief.meaningZh: 被大量要做的事壓得難以應付，可以是學校功課或家務。
brief.grammar: Be/feel buried in homework or buried under chores. Homework is uncountable; chores is plural. Buried is an overload metaphor, not a literal location.
brief.register: Informal-to-neutral overload metaphor; a student may describe homework to a classmate, while a householder may describe chores to family.
brief.boundaryZh: 形容負荷感，不自動等於學不懂、沒興趣或完全做不完；需看工作量與可用時間。
brief.misconceptionZh: 形容負荷感，不自動等於學不懂、沒興趣或完全做不完；需看工作量與可用時間。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「功課多得難以應付」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Both guide sources use the productive buried-in/under overload metaphor; homework and chores name different burdens, not different idiom senses.

listening.en: With three assignments due after the trip, I felt buried in homework even though I understood the topics; I asked the tutor which task needed attention first.
listening.zh: 旅行後有三份作業到期，雖然明白主題，我仍覺功課多得難應付；我問導師哪項應先處理。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 主要困難是多項功課同時到期帶來的負荷。
說話者表示所有主題都完全不明白。
導師已取消那三份作業，沒有工作剩下。
說話者只在回顧已交作業得到的分數。

listening.explanationZh: 三份功課同時到期，說明負荷沉重；雖然說話者理解題目內容，仍需商量先處理哪一項。錄音沒有說功課已取消或已交評分。

reply.promptEn: Why did you ask the tutor what to tackle first?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼問導師先處理甚麼？

options.en: I felt buried in homework with several assignments due together.
options.zh: 幾份作業同時到期，我覺功課多得難應付。

options.en: The amount of work was difficult to manage in the time available.
options.zh: 可用時間裏，工作量很難管理。

options.en: I understood the topics but needed help prioritising the tasks.
options.zh: 我明白主題，但需幫忙排任務先後。

options.en: Several deadlines came together, leaving me unsure where to start.
options.zh: 幾個期限一起到，令我不知從何開始。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生一周內有長篇閱讀、兩份練習及一個小組報告，感到時間不夠，但仍對內容有興趣。哪句貼切？

options.en: She feels buried in homework despite her interest in the subjects.
options.zh: 儘管對學科有興趣，她仍覺功課多得難應付。

options.en: She is describing a loss of interest rather than pressure from the workload.
options.zh: 她在描述失去興趣，而非工作量壓力。

options.en: The tasks have already been handed in and she is waiting only for marks.
options.zh: 任務已全部交了，她只在等分數。

scene.explanationZh: 多項任務與時間不夠是負荷，興趣仍在，也未交完。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 buried in homework 得出？

options.en: 功課量令人物感到難應付。
人物一定對所有學科都沒有興趣。
需看時間及任務，才知哪項支援有用。

contrast.explanationZh: 負荷與興趣是不同層面，不由忙碌推不喜歡。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「你說功課壓着你，是否每題都不懂？」你其實明白內容，只是幾個期限重疊。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: I am buried in homework because several tasks are due together, not because every question is unclear.
options.zh: 幾項同時到期令我功課多得難應付，不是每題都不明白。

options.en: Explain each topic from the beginning before we look at when the assignments are due.
options.zh: 先把每個主題由頭解釋，再看作業何時到期。

options.en: My main difficulty is understanding a new topic, rather than fitting the work into the week.
options.zh: 我主要難在明白新主題，而非把工作排進這周。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已說明內容明白，需聚焦重疊工作量，不把支援全改成重教主題。

speaking.en: I feel buried in homework this week, so I need to make the deadlines clear before choosing where to begin.
speaking.zh: 這周我覺功課多得難應付，所以選從哪開始前，需先列清期限。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清工作量與學習能力。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友邀你周六玩一整天，你這周有多份功課仍想赴約，但只能星期六傍晚見一小時。你想有禮解釋負荷並提出有限相聚，不把忙碌說成不想見朋友。用一至兩句英文回覆。

examples.en: I am buried in homework this week, but I would still like to see you. Could we meet for an hour on Saturday evening instead of spending the whole day out?
examples.zh: 這周我功課多得難應付，但仍想見你。可否改周六傍晚見一小時，而非整天外出？

examples.en: I feel buried in homework at the moment, so a full day would be hard to manage. I could join you for a short visit after I finish the afternoon task.
examples.zh: 現在我覺功課多得難應付，所以整天相聚難安排。下午任務做完後，我可短暫來見你。

writing.selfCheckZh: 禮貌說明負荷，保留想見朋友並提出有限時間，不把功課多變成興趣或友情已消失。

takeaways.en: She felt buried in homework when the reading tasks and project deadlines came together.
takeaways.zh: 閱讀任務及項目期限一起到時，她覺功課多得難應付。

takeaways.en: With the move approaching, I felt buried under chores, so my brother handled the packing list while I booked the van.
takeaways.zh: 快要搬家時，我覺得家務多得難以應付，於是哥哥處理執拾清單，我去預約搬運車。

lessons.titleEn: awareness is one thing, and action is another
lessons.titleZh: 知道是一回事，行動是另一回事

target.pattern: \bawareness is one thing,? and action is another\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: With exercise, awareness is one thing, and action is another.
sources.expression: awareness is one thing, and action is another

brief.meaningEn: Recognising an issue is distinct from taking practical steps in response.
brief.meaningZh: 認識問題與實際採取回應，是不同的事。
brief.grammar: awareness is one thing, and action is another; productive X-is-one-thing/Y-is-another contrast frame; names a distinction, not inevitable opposition
brief.boundaryZh: 不表示知道毫無價值，也不表示兩者不能並存；需有情境指出哪些行動仍需做。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不表示知道毫無價值，也不表示兩者不能並存；需有情境指出哪些行動仍需做。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「知道是一回事，行動是另一回事」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The organisers understood why step-free access mattered, but had not checked the entrance or arranged the route; awareness is one thing, and action is another, so we put those checks on the next meeting’s agenda.
listening.zh: 主辦者明白無梯級通道為何重要，卻未查入口或安排路線；知道是一回事，行動是另一回事，所以我們把核對列入下次會議議程。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 已認識需要，但實際通道核對仍待做。
大家已完成入口核對，會議只在報告結果。
說話者否定了解通道需要有任何價值。
主辦者正第一次認識無梯級通道的需要，還未明白為何重要。

listening.explanationZh: understood 表示已認識重要性，had not checked 才是未落實部分；不是首次才聽需要或已完成核對。

reply.promptEn: Why did you add the entrance checks to the agenda?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼把入口核對加進議程？

options.en: Awareness is one thing, and action is another; we had understood the need but not checked the route.
options.zh: 知道是一回事，行動是另一回事；我們明白需要，卻未查路線。

options.en: Understanding the issue had not yet led to the practical entrance checks.
options.zh: 明白問題仍未轉成實際入口核對。

options.en: The route needed checking even though the organisers already valued access.
options.zh: 儘管主辦者已重視通道，路線仍需核。

options.en: We wanted to follow the recognised need with concrete arrangements.
options.zh: 我們想在已認識的需要之後，作具體安排。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小組說知道發照片前需問同意，卻未問相中人便準備上載；你要提醒認識規則與實際做到有別。哪句貼切？

options.en: Awareness is one thing, and action is another; we still need to ask the people in the photograph.
options.zh: 知道是一回事，行動是另一回事；仍需問相中人。

options.en: Discussing consent already counts as receiving permission from the people pictured.
options.zh: 討論同意已算收到相中人的許可。

options.en: The group’s stated concern shows that asking permission is no longer relevant.
options.zh: 小組已說重視，顯示問許可不再相關。

scene.explanationZh: 知道需問未等於已問或已獲許可，需補實際回應。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 awareness is one thing, and action is another 得出？

options.en: 明白問題與作具體回應有別。
既然兩者有別，了解問題就不值得花時間。
情境可說明哪些實際步驟仍未做。

contrast.explanationZh: 區別並非貶低認識，也不否定兩者可相互支持。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「大家都說通道重要，這項就已處理好了吧？」入口仍未核。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: Awareness is one thing, and action is another; let us check the entrance and route before calling the arrangements ready.
options.zh: 知道是一回事，行動是另一回事；說安排好了前，先查入口及路線吧。

options.en: Move the route check out of the agenda because the discussion already showed concern.
options.zh: 討論已表達關心，所以把路線核對移出議程。

options.en: Begin another general awareness talk before assigning anyone to look at the actual entrance.
options.zh: 指定人看實際入口前，再開始另一場一般意識講座。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已認識需要後應落實眼前核對，不能只以關心或再講概念代替。

speaking.en: Awareness is one thing, and action is another; we need to ask what practical step follows this discussion.
speaking.zh: 知道是一回事，行動是另一回事；我們需問這討論之後有甚麼實際一步。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出認識與行動之間仍需做甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：街坊都說公園的野餐地方有垃圾，卻每次只在群組抱怨。你想在下次野餐前，邀兩位鄰居一起問管理處可用的清理安排，先做一小步，不責怪所有人也不聲稱已清乾淨。用一至兩句英文邀請。

examples.en: Awareness is one thing, and action is another; we all know about the litter, but could two of us ask the park office about a cleanup before the picnic? I would be happy to help arrange that first step.
examples.zh: 知道是一回事，行動是另一回事；我們都知有垃圾，但可否兩人先問公園辦事處野餐前的清理安排？我樂意幫安排這第一步。

examples.en: We have discussed the litter often, but awareness is one thing, and action is another. Would you join me in asking what cleanup arrangements are possible before our next picnic?
examples.zh: 我們常談垃圾，但知道是一回事，行動是另一回事。你願跟我問下次野餐前，可有甚麼清理安排嗎？

writing.selfCheckZh: 把已知問題轉成有禮邀請及可詢問的具體一步，保留安排仍待問，不把抱怨或認識當已清好。

takeaways.en: Awareness is one thing, and action is another; the team still needs to assign someone to follow up the request.
takeaways.zh: 知道是一回事，行動是另一回事；團隊仍需指定人跟進請求。

takeaways.en: She said awareness is one thing, and action is another when the discussion ended without any plan for what to do next.
takeaways.zh: 討論完仍沒有下一步計劃時，她說知道是一回事，行動是另一回事。

lessons.titleZh: 累得一屁股坐到沙發上

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: After the shift, I collapse onto the sofa.

brief.meaningEn: Sit or drop heavily onto a sofa because one feels very tired.
brief.meaningZh: 因很疲累而重重地坐下或倒到沙發上。
brief.grammar: collapse onto the sofa; collapsed/collapsing; vivid informal movement description, not necessarily fainting
brief.boundaryZh: 此處是疲累時坐倒的生動描述，不自帶昏厥、病名或已恢復精力的資訊；需按人物動作及上下文理解。
brief.misconceptionZh: 此處是疲累時坐倒的生動描述，不自帶昏厥、病名或已恢復精力的資訊；需按人物動作及上下文理解。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「累得一屁股坐到沙發上」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The guide labels this an idiom/set phrase. It is a natural vivid verb-plus-place description, not a fixed metaphor requiring a separate idiomatic meaning.

listening.en: After clearing the hall and carrying the last boxes home, I collapsed onto the sofa with my shoes still on; I wanted a quiet moment before answering the messages.
listening.zh: 清理禮堂、把最後幾箱搬回家後，我累得鞋還穿着就倒到沙發上；回覆訊息前，我想先安靜一會。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者疲累地坐倒，想先休息再回訊息。
說話者已回完全部訊息，現在準備搬箱。
說話者先從容脫鞋、回好訊息，才慢慢選一個舒服姿勢坐下。
說話者剛休息完，立即開始下一段搬運。

listening.explanationZh: shoes still on 及 before answering 交代疲累坐倒先於脫鞋及回訊息，不是已從容回完或休息完再搬。

reply.promptEn: Why did you not answer the messages straight away?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼沒立即回訊息？

options.en: I collapsed onto the sofa after carrying the boxes and needed a quiet moment.
options.zh: 搬箱後我累得倒到沙發上，需安靜一會。

options.en: I felt worn out after the clearing and wanted to pause first.
options.zh: 清理後我覺疲憊，想先停一下。

options.en: I sat down heavily before I had even taken off my shoes.
options.zh: 我連鞋未脫，就重重坐下。

options.en: The work had left me very tired, so I did not start replying immediately.
options.zh: 工作令我很累，所以沒立即開始回覆。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 故事人物完成一天探訪及來回車程，回到家重重坐到沙發，說先歇一下才拆信；敘述沒有失去知覺。哪句貼切？

options.en: She collapsed onto the sofa and left the letters for a little later.
options.zh: 她累得倒到沙發上，把信留稍後才拆。

options.en: She finished opening all the letters before sitting down.
options.zh: 她坐下前已拆完全部信。

options.en: She carefully settled on the sofa after first arranging the letters for an immediate reading session.
options.zh: 她先整理信件準備立即閱讀，才從容坐到沙發上。

scene.explanationZh: 重重坐下並先歇才拆信，與從容整理後立即讀信的先後及方式不同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜單憑此處 collapsed onto the sofa 得出？

options.en: 人物很累地坐下或倒到沙發上。
人物必定失去知覺，需要敘述中未提的救治。
上下文可交代此前忙甚麼及之後想休息。

contrast.explanationZh: 這裏的生動坐倒不等於昏厥，不能添未給事件。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「他重重坐下，那就已回好氣、可以立即接新工作吧？」敘述只說他想先安靜。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: He collapsed onto the sofa because he felt worn out; sitting down does not tell us he is ready for another task.
options.zh: 他因疲憊而倒到沙發上；坐下不顯示已準備接另一項。

options.en: Use his sitting down as confirmation that he has already finished resting.
options.zh: 把他坐下當已休息完的確認。

options.en: Ask him to begin sorting the next boxes before finding out whether he needs that quiet moment.
options.zh: 未問是否需安靜一會，就叫他開始分下一批箱。

dialogue.explanationZh: 疲累坐下是開始停歇，不是已恢復或已接受新工作。

speaking.en: I collapsed onto the sofa after the long afternoon and left the unopened letters on the table for a while.
speaking.zh: 漫長下午後，我累得倒到沙發上，未拆的信暫放桌上。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再留意疲累動作及先後。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替漫畫人物寫動作提示：他原打算回家後招呼朋友，卻在全天帶隊參觀後疲憊地重重坐倒在沙發，想先安靜一會。你想請畫家把疲累動作畫清楚，不畫成從容坐下立即主持聊天。用一至兩句英文說明畫面及之後暫停。

examples.en: Show him collapsing onto the sofa after the long day of guiding visitors, rather than settling neatly into a host’s chair. He wants a quiet pause before welcoming his friends.
examples.zh: 畫他帶隊參觀一整天後累得倒到沙發上，而非整齊從容坐到主人座位。他招呼朋友前想先安靜停一下。

examples.en: He collapses onto the sofa as soon as he gets home, with the evening’s conversation still ahead of him. I would draw the heavy movement and a brief pause, not a composed start to the gathering.
examples.zh: 他一回家就累得倒到沙發上，晚間談話仍未開始。我會畫重重坐下及短暫停歇，而非從容開始聚會。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以全天帶隊後的重重坐倒及暫停交代疲累，分清從容招呼與尚未開始談話，不添加昏厥事件。

takeaways.en: She collapsed onto the sofa after putting away the visitors’ bedding and asked for a few quiet minutes.
takeaways.zh: 收好客人床具後，她累得倒到沙發上，想安靜幾分鐘。

takeaways.en: He collapsed onto the sofa with the shopping bags beside him, glad to stop carrying things for a moment.
takeaways.zh: 他累得倒到沙發上，購物袋在旁，很高興暫時不用再搬東西。

lessons.titleEn: the lifestyle does not always cooperate

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: She wants to cook, but the lifestyle does not always cooperate.
sources.expression: the lifestyle does not always cooperate

brief.meaningEn: Everyday routines and circumstances do not always make an intended action easy to carry out.
brief.meaningZh: 日常安排與處境未必方便某項意願落實。
brief.grammar: want to..., but the lifestyle does not always cooperate; lifestyle is personified; name the practical clash rather than a person refusing cooperation
brief.boundaryZh: 指時間、工作或生活條件的阻礙，不是有個名叫生活的人反對；也不說意願虛假或困難永遠無法調整。
brief.misconceptionZh: 指時間、工作或生活條件的阻礙，不是有個名叫生活的人反對；也不說意願虛假或困難永遠無法調整。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「生活安排未必配合」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: A creative lifestyle personification, not a fixed idiom. Unlike the body-does-not-cooperate frame1624, this names external daily arrangements rather than physical capacity.

listening.en: In her diary, Leila wanted to cook with her sister more often, but her lifestyle does not always cooperate: changing shifts meant they were rarely free at the same time.
listening.zh: 日記中，蕾拉想更常跟姐姐做飯，但生活安排未必配合：輪班常改，令她們很少同時有空。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 想一起做飯，但輪班時間使共同空檔少。
姐姐已拒絕一起做飯，輪班時間完全沒影響。
兩人已固定每晚一起做飯，沒有時間衝突。
日記主要說蕾拉不喜歡任何烹調活動。

listening.explanationZh: wanted 與 changing shifts 區分意願及日常阻礙，未說姐姐拒絕或每晚已能一起。

reply.promptEn: Why was it hard for Leila to cook with her sister more often?
reply.promptZh: 蕾拉為甚麼難以更常跟姐姐做飯？

options.en: Her lifestyle does not always cooperate because their free time rarely overlaps.
options.zh: 共同空檔很少，所以她的生活安排未必配合。

options.en: Changing shifts made shared evenings difficult to arrange.
options.zh: 輪班常改，令共同晚上難安排。

options.en: The wish was there, but their daily schedules did not often match.
options.zh: 意願仍在，但日常時間表不常配合。

options.en: They needed an arrangement that could cope with different working hours.
options.zh: 她們需能配合不同工作時間的安排。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物想每周參加現場朗讀會，卻常臨時出城工作；他仍想參與，正在問有沒有錄音。哪句貼切？

options.en: He wants to join, but his lifestyle does not always cooperate.
options.zh: 他想參與，但生活安排未必配合。

options.en: His missed sessions show he no longer has any interest in reading.
options.zh: 他缺席，顯示已對閱讀沒有任何興趣。

options.en: The story says the group has stopped offering meetings altogether.
options.zh: 故事說小組已完全不辦聚會。

scene.explanationZh: 臨時工作行程是實際阻礙，問錄音保留興趣，不是活動停辦。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 the lifestyle does not always cooperate 得出？

options.en: 日常條件可能與某意願衝突。
人物想做某事的意願一定不真誠。
應找出具體時間或環境阻礙，才可談改法。

contrast.explanationZh: 有阻礙不否定意願真誠。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「不能常一起煮，表示她根本不想跟姐姐相處吧？」日記寫的是輪班難碰。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: Her lifestyle does not always cooperate; the diary gives a scheduling problem, not a lack of affection.
options.zh: 生活安排未必配合；日記交代時間衝突，不是沒感情。

options.en: Judge her wish only by the number of evenings they managed, without considering the changing shifts.
options.zh: 只按成功共度多少晚上判她意願，不考慮輪班常改。

options.en: Treat the missed evenings as the sister’s refusal, even though the diary names working hours.
options.zh: 日記雖指出工作時間，仍把錯過晚上當姐姐拒絕。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需保留已給時間原因，不由出席次數推感情或拒絕。

speaking.en: I want to make room for the project, but my lifestyle does not always cooperate when work changes at short notice.
speaking.zh: 我想為項目留空間，但工作臨時改動時，生活安排未必配合。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再找出意願與生活安排的實際衝突。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你想為家族口述歷史項目出力，但工作輪班常臨時改，無法保證每次現場錄音都到。你想提出可提早領一小份逐字稿，利用已確認的兩段空檔校對，現場工作另議人手，不直接消失或承諾每場都來。用一至兩句英文協商。

examples.en: I want to help with the family audio project, but my lifestyle does not always cooperate with fixed recording sessions. Could I check a short transcript in two agreed time slots while we arrange someone else for the live session?
examples.zh: 我想幫家族聲音項目，但生活安排未必配合固定錄音場次。可否讓我在兩段議定時間核短逐字稿，現場另找人？

examples.en: My lifestyle does not always cooperate when shifts change at short notice, although I want to contribute. I can take a small transcript in advance and agree a realistic checking date rather than promise to attend every recording.
examples.zh: 輪班臨時改時，生活安排未必配合，儘管我想貢獻。我可預先領小份逐字稿、議實際校對日，而非答應每場錄音都到。

writing.selfCheckZh: 坦白輪班與固定錄音衝突，提出有範圍的校對貢獻及協商日期，不把願意幫寫成能到每一場。

takeaways.en: She wanted to keep the shared meal, but her lifestyle does not always cooperate with a fixed evening time.
takeaways.zh: 她想保留共同晚餐，但生活安排未必配合固定晚間時間。

takeaways.en: My lifestyle does not always cooperate with long meetings, so I ask what I can contribute before they begin.
takeaways.zh: 生活安排未必配合長會，所以開始前我會問能先貢獻甚麼。

lessons.titleEn: the gap may actually grow wider

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Without support, the gap may actually grow wider.
sources.expression: the gap may actually grow wider

brief.meaningEn: The difference between specified groups or conditions may become greater, contrary to an expectation.
brief.meaningZh: 指定群體或情況之間的差距，可能反而增大。
brief.grammar: the gap between X and Y may actually grow wider; may preserves possibility; actually often contrasts with an expected narrowing
brief.boundaryZh: 需指出誰與誰的差距及比較甚麼，不是實際裂縫，也不把可能警告當已量度結果。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需指出誰與誰的差距及比較甚麼，不是實際裂縫，也不把可能警告當已量度結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「差距可能反而更大」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: A productive comparison clause, not a fixed whole idiom. Related to a widening gap1375; this frame additionally teaches the modal warning and contrast with expectation, without inventing a separate dictionary sense.

listening.en: The centre hoped online bookings would help everyone, but the gap may actually grow wider if people without reliable access receive no other way to reserve a place; the report was a warning, not a new count.
listening.zh: 中心希望網上預約幫到所有人，但若沒可靠網絡的人沒有其他預約方法，差距可能反而更大；報告是警告，不是新統計。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 新方式若無後備，群體預約機會差距可能加大。
報告已量得每個群體的最新預約成功率。
報告只擔心所有預約同樣變慢，不涉及群體使用機會不同。
報告認為只要有新系統，兩群體差距便一定縮小。

listening.explanationZh: without reliable access 與 no other way 指不同群體的使用機會，不是所有人同樣速度慢；may/if 仍是警告。

reply.promptEn: What risk does the report identify about online-only booking?
reply.promptZh: 報告指出只用網上預約有甚麼風險？

options.en: The gap may actually grow wider if people without reliable access have no alternative.
options.zh: 沒可靠網絡的人若沒替代，差距可能反而更大。

options.en: The new method could leave some people further behind in getting a place.
options.zh: 新方法可能令一些人在取得名額方面更落後。

options.en: Access to reservations might become less equal rather than more equal.
options.zh: 取得預約的機會可能更不平等，而非更平等。

options.en: It warns of a larger difference in opportunity, not a measured new result.
options.zh: 它警告機會差距可能更大，而非報已量度新結果。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學校本想用付費額外指導縮小作品製作能力差距，但只有本已資源較多的一群可參加；你要提出可能反效果，未有新成績。哪句貼切？

options.en: The gap may actually grow wider if the extra help reaches only those who already have more support.
options.zh: 額外協助若只到已有較多支援的人，差距可能反而更大。

options.en: The latest results already show that every group improved by the same amount.
options.zh: 最新成績已顯示各組改善程度相同。

options.en: Offering an activity proves that the difference in access has already disappeared.
options.zh: 提供活動，證明使用機會差距已消失。

scene.explanationZh: 只有資源多者可用可能擴差距，未有新成績，也不能用活動存在代平等。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 the gap may actually grow wider 得出？

options.en: 差距增大是值得留意的可能情況。
差距已按最新數據確認增大。
需交代比較群體及條件，才明白這警告。

contrast.explanationZh: may 的可能不等於已量度增大。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把「可能擴大」寫成「已擴大一倍」，但報告只列條件風險。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: The gap may actually grow wider, but we need new evidence before stating how much it has changed.
options.zh: 差距可能反而更大，但說已改多少前需新證據。

options.en: Use the warning itself as the size of the increase in the latest results.
options.zh: 把警告本身當最新結果的增加幅度。

options.en: Since the new figures are not available, leave the access risk out of the discussion.
options.zh: 既沒有新數字，討論就不提使用機會風險。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留條件風險與未知實際幅度，不編數字，也不因未量而漏風險。

speaking.en: The gap may actually grow wider if new support is available only to the people who already have the most help.
speaking.zh: 新支援若只供已有最多幫助的人，差距可能反而更大。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留可能、條件及比較對象。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你與朋友策劃寫作交流，打算只邀已出版的人參加專業討論；你擔心初學者因此更難接觸實際回饋。你要有禮提出風險，問可否另留一小段歡迎新人提問，不假裝已看到活動成效。用一至兩句英文建議。

examples.en: The gap may actually grow wider if only published writers can hear the practical feedback. Could we reserve a short question period for beginners too?
examples.zh: 若只有已出版作者能聽實際回饋，差距可能反而更大。可否也為初學者留短提問時間？

examples.en: I worry that the gap may actually grow wider between experienced writers and newcomers if the discussion stays closed. A brief open session could give beginners a way to ask for guidance.
examples.zh: 我擔心若討論保持封閉，資深作者與新人間的差距可能反而更大。短公開環節可讓初學者有方法尋求指引。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出經驗及回饋機會的比較，保留可能風險並提開放一小段的建議，不把活動計劃當已有成效數據。

takeaways.en: The gap may actually grow wider when useful information reaches only the people already well connected.
takeaways.zh: 有用資訊若只到本已有良好人脈的人，差距可能反而更大。

takeaways.en: The gap may actually grow wider, she warned, unless the new service also reaches the people it was meant to include.
takeaways.zh: 她警告，除非新服務也到達原本想納入的人，否則差距可能反而更大。

brief.meaningEn: Deliberately embrace and develop a quality or practice instead of merely noticing it or resisting it; engagement does not itself prove a successful result.
brief.meaningZh: 有意識地擁抱並發展一種特質或做法，而非只注意到它或抗拒它；投入本身不證明已有成果。
brief.grammar: Lean/leans/leaned/leant/leaning into healthy habits or its/their local character. Into takes the quality or practice being actively embraced; the source personifies a festival as choosing to emphasise its local identity.
brief.register: A coach can use this contemporary, somewhat informal phrasal verb with a learner about habits; a festival organiser can use it with colleagues about local identity. The objects are contextual uses of the same verb, not fixed idioms requiring those exact nouns.
brief.boundaryZh: 說明主動投入或強調某特質，不保證健康已有改善，也不表示地方特色是唯一值得保留的面向；須看實際行動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 收藏目標清單不等於投入健康習慣；活動以地方特色設計內容，也不等於拒絕所有新元素。
brief.outcomeZh: 能從具體行動判斷某人或機構是否主動擁抱習慣或地方特色，並避免誇大結果。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Oxford lean into attests accepting a challenge and trying hard. Healthy habits is a contextual object, not a separate fixed idiom. Fictional personal routines illustrate engagement without prescribing a regimen.

listening.en: In the novel, Sam decided to lean into healthy habits rather than keep collecting advice: he planned his own lunch break and asked a friend to help him protect that time during busy weeks.
listening.zh: 小說中，森決定更主動投入健康習慣，而非只收集資訊：他安排自己的午餐休息，並請朋友幫他在忙周保留時間。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 他開始具體投入自己的日常目標，而非只收資訊。
他已得到所有習慣改善身體的實測結果。
他只在收集更多資訊，未想落實任何安排。
朋友替他決定所有生活選擇，沒有問他的目標。

listening.explanationZh: planned 與 asked 表現主動投入；未給身體成效或朋友代作全部決定。

reply.promptEn: What changed in Sam’s approach to his daily goals?
reply.promptZh: 森對日常目標的做法有甚麼改變？

options.en: He began to lean into healthy habits by protecting a lunch break he had chosen.
options.zh: 他保留自己選的午餐休息，開始更主動投入健康習慣。

options.en: He moved from collecting advice to making a specific arrangement.
options.zh: 他由收集資訊，轉為作具體安排。

options.en: He asked for practical support to keep time for his own routine.
options.zh: 他請求實際支援，為自己的習慣保留時間。

options.en: His plan involved participation rather than simply storing suggestions.
options.zh: 他的計劃涉及參與，而非只儲存建議。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 社區書店不再只用連鎖店的統一陳列，開始展示本區作者的書，並讓居民選擇口述歷史活動的題目；它仍出售其他書籍。哪句貼切？

options.en: The bookshop is leaning into its local character through specific choices, without excluding every other kind of book.
options.zh: 書店透過具體安排更主動突出自身的地方特色，但沒有排除所有其他類型的書。

options.en: The bookshop has kept only the same chain-store display and made no local choices.
options.zh: 書店只保留原有的連鎖店式陳列，沒有作出任何地方特色的安排。

options.en: The local display proves that every resident now prefers the same books.
options.zh: 地方主題陳列證明所有居民現在都喜歡相同的書。

scene.explanationZh: 展示本區作者及讓居民選題，是主動突出地方特色；並無證據說其他書被排除或所有人喜好相同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 lean into healthy habits 得出？

options.en: 更主動參與相關日常安排。
單憑這用語已知個人的健康指標改善。
情境應交代習慣及投入方式，不只用抽象標語。

contrast.explanationZh: 投入描述不等於健康結果數據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「他只有午餐休息計劃，哪能說成效已證實？」你本來只說他開始投入。哪句澄清較準確？

options.en: I said he was starting to lean into healthy habits, not that the story had proved a health result.
options.zh: 我說他開始更主動投入健康習慣，不是故事已證健康成效。

options.en: Count the new plan itself as the measured improvement, without waiting for any observation.
options.zh: 不用等觀察，把新計劃本身算作已量度改善。

options.en: Because no result is reported, leave out the concrete effort he has already made.
options.zh: 既沒報成果，就不提他已作的具體努力。

dialogue.explanationZh: 投入可真實存在而結果未報，不把兩者合併，也不抹去努力。

speaking.en: He wanted to lean into healthy habits by making room for the routine he had chosen, rather than just saving more advice.
speaking.zh: 他想為自己選的安排留空間，更主動投入健康習慣，而非只儲存更多資訊。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清投入行動與結果。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：故事中，你與朋友自己選了下班後到公園散步作日常目標，朋友願陪你，也尊重你有時需改時間。你想感謝陪伴，承諾自己提早核哪天可行、若加班先聯絡，而不只談新器材或讓朋友追着問。用一至兩句英文表達主動投入。

examples.en: Thank you for joining the walks we chose; I want to lean into healthy habits by taking responsibility for our shared arrangements. I will check the time in advance and let you know if work changes.
examples.zh: 謝謝你參與我們選的散步；我想負責共同安排，更主動投入健康習慣。我會提早核時間，若工作改動便告訴你。

examples.en: Your company encourages me to lean into healthy habits rather than only discuss new equipment. I can help plan the park visits and contact you early when we need another time.
examples.zh: 你的陪伴鼓勵我更主動投入健康習慣，而不只談新器材。我可幫安排公園散步，需另選時間時及早聯絡你。

writing.selfCheckZh: 感謝已選共同活動的支持，以自己提早安排及聯絡作投入，不把參與意願當健康結果已證或把責任全交朋友。

takeaways.en: She began to lean into healthy habits by discussing which of her chosen routines she could realistically keep.
takeaways.zh: 她討論自己選的哪些安排實際可維持，開始更主動投入健康習慣。

takeaways.en: The bookshop leaned into its local character by featuring neighbourhood writers beside the usual titles.
takeaways.zh: 書店在一般書目旁重點展示本區作家的作品，更主動突出自身的地方特色。

lessons.titleZh: 被相反的力量或選擇拉扯

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Long work hours can leave people pulled in the opposite direction.

brief.meaningEn: Influenced towards a choice or aim that conflicts with a previously identified direction.
brief.meaningZh: 受到影響，傾向與先前目標相反的選擇或方向。
brief.grammar: be/feel pulled in the opposite direction; passive influence metaphor; opposite needs an established comparison
brief.boundaryZh: 須先有原目標及相反影響，不只一般忙碌；被拉扯不表示已完全放棄或失去選擇。
brief.misconceptionZh: 須先有原目標及相反影響，不只一般忙碌；被拉扯不表示已完全放棄或失去選擇。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「被相反的力量或選擇拉扯」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: We wanted to spend the final edit checking uncertain captions, but the request for an earlier launch left us pulled in the opposite direction, towards finishing quickly rather than investigating the gaps.
listening.zh: 我們想把最後編輯時間用來核不確定圖說，但提早發布的要求令我們被拉往相反方向，傾向快完而非查缺漏。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 核資料的目標與趕快發布的要求形成拉扯。
提早發布的要求讓小組多了核資料的時間。
全部缺漏已查妥，小組只在選發布日期。
小組的兩項要求原本完全一樣，沒有取捨。

listening.explanationZh: checking uncertain captions 對比 finishing quickly，指出相反壓力，未定已放棄或已全查。

reply.promptEn: Why was the earlier launch request difficult for the editors?
reply.promptZh: 提早發布的要求為甚麼令編輯為難？

options.en: It left us pulled in the opposite direction from the careful checking we had planned.
options.zh: 它令我們被拉往與原定仔細核對相反的方向。

options.en: It encouraged speed when we had intended to investigate the remaining gaps.
options.zh: 我們原想查剩餘缺漏，它卻鼓勵趕快。

options.en: The new timing competed with the purpose of the final edit.
options.zh: 新時間要求與最後編輯目的互相競爭。

options.en: We had to consider two pressures that did not point towards the same choice.
options.zh: 我們需考慮兩股不指向同一選擇的壓力。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物原想留周末完成自己的長篇創作，卻被臨時短片合作邀請吸引，兩者都需同一時段；她未決定。哪句貼切？

options.en: She feels pulled in the opposite direction by the new invitation.
options.zh: 新邀請令她覺得被拉往相反方向。

options.en: The invitation gives her more uninterrupted time for the original long piece.
options.zh: 邀請讓她有更多不中斷時間做原長篇。

options.en: She has already chosen the short-film project and set the long piece aside for another week.
options.zh: 她已選短片合作，把長篇留另一周。

scene.explanationZh: 題目明說仍未決，兩項需同一時間形成拉扯，不是已選工作坊或多了原創作時間。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 pulled in the opposite direction？

options.en: 原目標與新影響鼓勵相互衝突的選擇。
新協助讓人物更容易朝原來選定的目標前進。
情境交代原方向，再說另一股力量要帶往哪。

contrast.explanationZh: 支持原方向不構成相反拉扯。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「既然提早，就省核對直接出吧？」你仍重視原定查缺漏。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: We are being pulled in the opposite direction, so let us make the conflict explicit before agreeing what can change.
options.zh: 我們正被拉往相反方向，所以議改甚麼前，先說清衝突吧。

options.en: Let the earlier date decide the editing scope before we discuss which captions remain uncertain.
options.zh: 未談哪些圖說仍不確定，就讓提早日期決定編輯範圍。

options.en: Ask only how to speed up the cover design and leave the checking conflict out of the meeting.
options.zh: 只問如何加快封面設計，會議不談核對衝突。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先說清取捨再協商，不以新時點或另一可見工作迴避核心衝突。

speaking.en: I felt pulled in the opposite direction when the new request competed with the time I had set aside for the original goal.
speaking.zh: 新要求與為原目標留的時間互相競爭時，我覺被拉往相反方向。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再找出兩股方向各指甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你已答應周日陪弟弟試做舞台模型，朋友卻臨時邀你參加很吸引的整天工作坊。你想向朋友坦白自己受到拉扯，但不取消已答應的陪伴，問下次是否還有短場次。用一至兩句英文有禮回覆。

examples.en: Your workshop sounds exciting, and I feel pulled in the opposite direction from the promise I made to my brother. I will keep Sunday for him, but could you tell me about a future short session?
examples.zh: 你的工作坊很吸引，我覺被拉往與答應弟弟相反的方向。我會保留周日陪他，但可否告訴我日後的短場次？

examples.en: I am pulled in the opposite direction by the invitation, but I have already promised to help with my brother’s model. Please let me know if there is another session I could join later.
examples.zh: 邀請令我被拉往相反方向，但我已答應幫弟弟做模型。若日後有另一場我可參與，請告訴我。

writing.selfCheckZh: 肯定邀請吸引力與既有承諾的衝突，清楚作當次選擇並問替代，不把被拉扯當已失去選擇。

takeaways.en: She felt pulled in the opposite direction when the promotion required evenings she had promised to her family.
takeaways.zh: 晉升要求她已答應留給家人的晚上時，她覺被拉往相反方向。

takeaways.en: We were pulled in the opposite direction by the rush to publish, although our original aim was to check the story carefully.
takeaways.zh: 匆忙發布令我們被拉往相反方向，儘管原目標是仔細核故事。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Technology may raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor.
sources.expression: raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor

brief.meaningEn: Improve the best attainable outcomes without necessarily improving outcomes for those starting from the lowest level.
brief.meaningZh: 提升可達的最佳水平，卻未必改善起點或結果最低者的情況。
brief.grammar: a tool may raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor; ceiling/floor are comparative outcome metaphors; identify the groups and outcomes
brief.boundaryZh: 不是說較弱者必無進步，也不否定提高上限價值；may not 留可能，需看低端實際所得。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說較弱者必無進步，也不否定提高上限價值；may not 留可能，需看低端實際所得。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「提高上限，卻未必改善最低水平」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: An extended inequality metaphor rather than a fixed whole idiom. Related ceiling-limit wording does not by itself establish this contrast between maximum achievement and the lowest outcomes.

listening.en: The new editing tool may raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor: experienced writers can shape more complex stories with it, while beginners still need help making a clear first paragraph.
listening.zh: 新編輯工具可能提高上限，卻未必改善最低水平：熟手可用它塑造更複雜故事，初學者仍需幫忙寫清楚首段。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 工具擴充熟手可能，但初學者的基本需要仍在。
工具已證明每名初學者都與熟手達到同水平。
說話者主張複雜故事不值得再發展。
工具主要改善初學者的首段，熟手較複雜寫作的可能並沒增加。

listening.explanationZh: experienced writers 可寫更複雜而 beginners still need help，對比高端可能增加與入門需要未滿足，不是受惠方向倒轉。

reply.promptEn: What limitation does the speaker see in the editing tool?
reply.promptZh: 說話者看見編輯工具有甚麼限制？

options.en: It may raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor if beginners still need basic support.
options.zh: 初學者若仍需基本支援，它可能提高上限，卻未必改善最低水平。

options.en: The most experienced users may gain options that do not address beginners’ first difficulty.
options.zh: 最熟手可能多選項，但未處理初學者第一個困難。

options.en: More advanced possibilities do not necessarily make the first paragraph easier for a new writer.
options.zh: 更高階可能，未必令新人較容易寫首段。

options.en: The tool could extend high-level work while leaving basic learning needs unmet.
options.zh: 工具可能擴充高階作品，基本學習需要卻仍未滿足。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 新資料平台讓資深研究者可比更多資料，但初學者仍不懂怎辨來源，未獲額外指導；你要談上限與最低需要的差別。哪句貼切？

options.en: It may raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor for learners who still need source guidance.
options.zh: 它可能提高上限，卻未必改善仍需來源指導者的最低水平。

options.en: More advanced comparisons show that beginners have already learned to evaluate sources.
options.zh: 更多高階比較顯示初學者已學會評來源。

options.en: The platform should be judged only by its most advanced feature, without looking at beginners’ needs.
options.zh: 平台只應按最高階功能評價，不看初學者需要。

scene.explanationZh: 高階多資料不等於入門識辨需要已獲支持；需分看兩端。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor 得出？

options.en: 最高可達成就可能提升，較低端仍有未滿足需要。
提高高階可能必定令較低端的人表現倒退。
需指出 ceiling 與 floor 各比較哪種成果。

contrast.explanationZh: 未必改善不等於必然倒退。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「熟手作品更複雜，就證明新人也受惠一樣多吧？」新人仍卡在首段。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: The tool can raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor; we should ask what support the beginners actually receive.
options.zh: 工具可提高上限，卻未必改善最低水平；應問初學者實際獲甚麼支援。

options.en: Use the advanced stories alone to decide whether the first-paragraph difficulty has been addressed.
options.zh: 只用高階故事判首段困難是否已處理。

options.en: Stop collecting beginners’ feedback because the most experienced writers can already do more.
options.zh: 熟手已能做更多，所以停止收初學者回饋。

dialogue.explanationZh: 高階成果不能代替入門需要評估，仍需問較低端所得。

speaking.en: A new tool can raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor unless beginners receive the support they need.
speaking.zh: 若初學者沒得到所需支援，新工具可提高上限，卻未必改善最低水平。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清高階可能與入門需要。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校際工作坊報告只列最熟練參加者做出的精細木印，主辦者想說新設備令所有水平都受惠。你想回覆肯定高階作品，但請另外聽初次參加者能否開始基本任務，再寫成效摘要。用一至兩句英文提出較公平的評估方法。

examples.en: The equipment can raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor simply because the best prints are impressive. Could we hear from first-time participants before describing the benefits across the whole group?
examples.zh: 器材可提高上限，卻未必因最佳木印出色就改善最低水平。描述整組所得前，可否先聽初次參加者意見？

examples.en: It may raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor for people who still cannot begin the basic task. I would recognise the advanced work and ask about those first steps before writing the summary.
examples.zh: 它可能提高上限，卻未必改善仍無法開始基本任務者的最低水平。我會肯定高階作品，並先問入門第一步才寫摘要。

writing.selfCheckZh: 肯定已見高階作品而不以最高成果代全體效果，提出聽入門經驗後才寫摘要，不聲稱設備有害或已知所有人成效。

takeaways.en: The platform could raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor if the simplest task still leaves new users confused.
takeaways.zh: 若最簡單任務仍令新人困惑，平台可提高上限，卻未必改善最低水平。

takeaways.en: The upgrade can raise the ceiling, but it may not lift the floor if basic guidance is left out.
takeaways.zh: 若缺基本指導，升級可提高上限，卻未必改善最低水平。

lessons.titleEn: turn good intentions into daily habits
lessons.titleZh: 把善意願望變成每日習慣

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A timetable helps turn good intentions into daily habits.
sources.expression: turn good intentions into daily habits

brief.meaningEn: Translate worthwhile intentions into actions repeated in everyday life.
brief.meaningZh: 把良好意願落實成日常反覆做的行動。
brief.grammar: turn good intentions into daily habits; turned/turning; turn X into Y is a productive change pattern, not a guarantee that announcing a plan creates a habit
brief.boundaryZh: 要有重複行動及可持續安排，不只是決心或一次嘗試；也不由有安排推未來一定從不間斷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要有重複行動及可持續安排，不只是決心或一次嘗試；也不由有安排推未來一定從不間斷。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「把善意願望變成每日習慣」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The supplied guide calls the full wording an idiom. Turn X into Y is a conventional productive change frame; daily habits names a specific intended result.

listening.en: Leaving the music open and agreeing a short practice time helped me turn good intentions into daily habits; I began returning to a few bars each evening rather than only promising to improve.
listening.zh: 把樂譜攤開並議短練習時間，幫我把良好意願變成每日習慣；我開始每晚回到幾小節，而不只承諾進步。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 具體準備及重複練習，把願望落實成日常行動。
說話者只宣布目標，尚未回到樂譜練習。
說話者只在偶爾空出整個下午才集中練，並非每晚回到幾小節。
練習時間主要由臨時有人提議才開始，沒有固定安排。

listening.explanationZh: each evening 及短練習時段支持日常重複，不是只宣告或偶爾一大段。

reply.promptEn: What helped you practise more consistently?
reply.promptZh: 甚麼幫你較穩定地練習？

options.en: The open music and agreed time helped turn good intentions into daily habits.
options.zh: 攤開樂譜及議定時間，幫我把良好意願變成每日習慣。

options.en: I had a specific place to begin and a small time slot to return to.
options.zh: 我有具體起點及可反覆回到的小時段。

options.en: A few bars each evening made the intention part of ordinary life.
options.zh: 每晚幾小節，讓意願成為平常生活一部分。

options.en: I started doing the practice repeatedly, instead of just saying I wanted to improve.
options.zh: 我開始反覆練，而非只說想進步。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物想記住家人故事，原每次只說改天寫；後來晚餐後記一句，連續在小簿留下每日片段。哪句貼切？

options.en: The small writing routine helped her turn good intentions into daily habits.
options.zh: 小寫作安排幫她把良好意願變成每日習慣。

options.en: She has still made no entries and only repeats the intention to begin later.
options.zh: 她仍沒有寫下任何內容，只重複日後開始的意願。

options.en: Her routine is to collect the stories only at occasional family gatherings, rather than return to them daily.
options.zh: 她的安排只是在偶爾家庭聚會收故事，而非每日回到這工作。

scene.explanationZh: 每天記一句是持續落實，不是尚未寫下，或只在偶爾大聚會做。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 turn good intentions into daily habits？

options.en: 能說明普通日子反覆做的具體行動。
只作一次熱烈宣布，未開始任何重複行動。
有實際安排幫人由想做進到常做。

contrast.explanationZh: 一次宣布表達意願，不確立日常反覆。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我已買新簿並宣布會寫，這就算養成每日習慣吧？」新簿仍空白。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: To turn good intentions into daily habits, you still need a small repeated action, not just the notebook and announcement.
options.zh: 要把良好意願變成每日習慣，仍需小小反覆行動，不只簿及宣布。

options.en: Spend the next week choosing a more elaborate notebook before deciding when to try a short entry.
options.zh: 未決定何時試寫一小段，先花下周選更精巧的筆記簿。

options.en: Wait for a whole free afternoon before trying even one short entry.
options.zh: 連寫一小段也先等整個空閒下午才試。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可先選小小可重複行動，不必等整段空閒或繼續只挑工具；宣布及簿仍非習慣。

speaking.en: A small repeatable action can help us turn good intentions into daily habits without relying on a fresh burst of enthusiasm each time.
speaking.zh: 小小可重複行動，可幫我們把良好意願變成每日習慣，而不用每次靠新熱情。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再找實際重複行動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你和室友常說想保持共用桌面可用，卻只在客人來前大清理。你想邀他試一周，每晚各花兩分鐘把自己的物件收好，周末再看合不合用；不把試行承諾當已成功。用一至兩句英文提議。

examples.en: Could we try to turn good intentions into daily habits by clearing our own things from the shared table for two minutes each evening? We can review the arrangement after a week.
examples.zh: 可否試每晚各花兩分鐘，從共用桌收好自己的東西，把良好意願變成每日習慣？一周後可檢視安排。

examples.en: I would like us to turn good intentions into daily habits rather than wait for visitors before clearing the table. Shall we try a brief evening reset and see whether it suits us?
examples.zh: 我想把良好意願變成每日習慣，而非客人來前才收桌。可否試晚間短整理，再看是否合用？

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出明確小規模重複試行及共同檢視，區分工具、宣告與實做，不把一周計劃寫成永久習慣已定。

takeaways.en: The regular reminder helped them turn good intentions into daily habits, one short action at a time.
takeaways.zh: 定時提醒幫他們一次一小行動，把良好意願變成每日習慣。

takeaways.en: We wanted to turn good intentions into daily habits, so we chose something small enough to repeat on ordinary days.
takeaways.zh: 我們想把良好意願變成每日習慣，所以選平常日子也可重複的小事。

lessons.titleEn: point them in the right direction
lessons.titleZh: 給人指向有用的方向或途徑

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: If students are unsure, a librarian can point them in the right direction.
sources.expression: point them in the right direction

brief.meaningEn: Guide someone towards a helpful option, source or first step.
brief.meaningZh: 引導某人找到有用選項、來源或第一步。
brief.grammar: point someone in the right direction; point us towards a useful source is a paraphrase; help guides rather than necessarily completes the task
brief.boundaryZh: 給途徑不等於代做、已解決或保證來源必適合；需指出對方要找甚麼及可從哪開始。
brief.misconceptionZh: 給途徑不等於代做、已解決或保證來源必適合；需指出對方要找甚麼及可從哪開始。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「給人指向有用的方向或途徑」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: I did not know where to ask about the old photographs, but the museum volunteer pointed me in the right direction by naming the local archive and the person who handles its picture collection.
listening.zh: 我不知去哪問舊照片，但博物館義工指出本地檔案館及管圖片收藏的人，給我有用方向。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 義工提供可開始詢問的地方及聯絡角色。
義工已替說話者找齊所有照片及日期。
說話者只問往出口的實際轉彎，沒有資料需要。
義工拒絕提供任何可能的資料來源。

listening.explanationZh: 命名檔案館及負責人是來源引導，不是已替找齊或出口指路。

reply.promptEn: How did the museum volunteer help your search?
reply.promptZh: 博物館義工怎幫你搜尋？

options.en: She pointed me in the right direction by naming the archive and its picture contact.
options.zh: 她指出檔案館及圖片聯絡人，給我有用方向。

options.en: She gave me a relevant place to start asking about the photographs.
options.zh: 她給我可開始問照片的相關地方。

options.en: I left with a source and a contact role to follow up.
options.zh: 離開時，我有可跟進的來源及聯絡角色。

options.en: Her help guided my next step without completing the whole search.
options.zh: 她的幫助引導下一步，未替我完成整個搜尋。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 新同事不知向誰問共享器材借用，旁人告訴他負責人及哪份指南有流程；他仍需自己提出申請。哪句貼切？

options.en: They pointed him in the right direction for the equipment request.
options.zh: 他們為器材申請給了他有用方向。

options.en: They completed and approved the request on his behalf before he asked.
options.zh: 他未問前，他們已代他完成及批准申請。

options.en: They gave him directions to the room without identifying who could explain the process.
options.zh: 他們只給去房間的路，未指出誰可解流程。

scene.explanationZh: 負責人及流程指南是可用途徑；申請仍需做，不只房間路線。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 pointed them in the right direction 得出？

options.en: 提供有用來源或下一步的引導。
他們需要完成的整項任務已由對方代做。
上下文可指出引導關乎資料、選項或實際步驟。

contrast.explanationZh: 指引未必完成全部任務。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「義工給了檔案館名字，照片出處就已查好了吧？」你仍需跟進。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: She pointed me in the right direction, but I still need to contact the archive and check the photographs.
options.zh: 她給我有用方向，但我仍需聯絡檔案館及查照片。

options.en: Send the query to a general museum address instead of following up the archive contact she named.
options.zh: 不跟進她指出的檔案館聯絡人，把查詢寄博物館一般地址。

options.en: Start writing the final captions before following up the contact she suggested.
options.zh: 未跟進她建議聯絡人，就開始寫最後圖說。

dialogue.explanationZh: 義工已給相關來源及聯絡角色，應跟進核查，不改投一般地址或未問就定稿。

speaking.en: Could you point me in the right direction for someone who can explain the process? I am ready to do the next step myself.
speaking.zh: 可否給我方向，找能解釋流程的人？下一步我準備自己做。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清引導與代做。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：新鄰居想辦小型街坊聚餐，問你借用共用院子的規則；你不熟悉，想介紹樓內負責人及住戶指南，並坦白不是你能批准。用一至兩句英文提供有用起點，不猜規則。

examples.en: I can point you in the right direction: the residents’ guide names the person responsible for courtyard bookings. Please ask them about the gathering, as I cannot approve it myself.
examples.zh: 我可給你有用方向：住戶指南列出負責院子預約的人。請問他們聚會安排，因我不能自己批准。

examples.en: The building coordinator could point you in the right direction about using the courtyard. I can show you the contact details, but you would still need to check the rules with them.
examples.zh: 大廈統籌可給你使用院子的有用方向。我可給聯絡資料，但你仍需跟他們核規則。

writing.selfCheckZh: 坦白自己權限，提供具體人或指南作起點，不把指引說成已批准或猜未核規則。

takeaways.en: A colleague pointed us in the right direction when we needed advice on how to submit the drawings.
takeaways.zh: 我們需問如何交圖時，同事給了有用方向。

takeaways.en: I could not answer the question myself, but I pointed her in the right direction for someone who knew the collection.
takeaways.zh: 我不能自己答，但給她方向找熟悉收藏的人。

lessons.titleZh: 像水中漣漪般向外傳開

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: One kind gesture created a ripple in water across the team.

brief.meaningEn: Spreading from a small beginning to affect others, through an explicit water-wave comparison.
brief.meaningZh: 以水中小波紋作明喻，描述由小起點向外影響別人。
brief.grammar: an action/feeling spreads like a ripple in water; like marks the comparison; specify what spreads and the observed response
brief.boundaryZh: 不是實際水災，也不保證一次行動改變每個人；需有具體傳播線索，並分清觀察與希望。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是實際水災，也不保證一次行動改變每個人；需有具體傳播線索，並分清觀察與希望。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「像水中漣漪般向外傳開」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The exact guide example awkwardly combines created a ripple in water with across the team. Learner wording is transparently normalised to an explicit like-a-ripple comparison, preserving the water image and provenance. Oxford ripple_1 attests spreading literal waves and figurative feelings; this is a creative simile, related to924ripple effect, not a new fixed idiom.

listening.en: When one visitor made room for a newcomer at the crowded table, the welcome spread like a ripple in water: nearby guests began introducing themselves and drawing other quiet people into the conversation.
listening.zh: 擠滿人的桌旁，一位訪客讓位給新人後，歡迎氣氛像水中漣漪傳開：旁邊來賓開始自我介紹，也讓其他安靜的人加入談話。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 一個讓位行動帶動附近更多人主動接納別人。
只有最初讓位的人說話，其他人沒有反應。
附近來賓各自同時發起接納，敘述沒有一個舉動帶動下一個的先後。
來賓已互相熟悉，介紹只在重複原有關係，沒有新接納行動。

listening.explanationZh: when one visitor...附近來賓 began 表示最初舉動之後的帶動，而非各自同時獨立發起或沒有新反應。

reply.promptEn: What happened after the visitor welcomed the newcomer?
reply.promptZh: 訪客接納新人後，發生甚麼？

options.en: The welcome spread like a ripple in water as nearby guests began including others.
options.zh: 旁邊來賓開始接納別人，歡迎氣氛像水中漣漪傳開。

options.en: Other people picked up the welcoming behaviour.
options.zh: 其他人也開始作接納行動。

options.en: The small gesture encouraged introductions around the table.
options.zh: 小舉動帶動桌旁互相介紹。

options.en: The first invitation was followed by more efforts to include quiet guests.
options.zh: 第一次邀請後，更多人嘗試讓安靜來賓加入。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 同事把自己整理的工具說明分享給新人，新人再補易懂圖片，另一人也整理自己的資料；你想形容小合作逐漸帶動更多分享。哪句貼切？

options.en: The willingness to share spread like a ripple in water.
options.zh: 分享意願像水中漣漪般傳開。

options.en: The first guide remained the only shared resource, with no further response.
options.zh: 首份指南仍是唯一分享資源，沒後續回應。

options.en: The later contributions all appeared before anyone shared the first guide.
options.zh: 別人後來的貢獻，全在首份指南分享前出現。

scene.explanationZh: 首份分享後連續有人補充，是向外帶動，不是無回應或時間倒轉。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 like a ripple in water 的此處明喻得出？

options.en: 某個小行動的影響逐漸向外傳開。
一次善意已保證每個人日後都採相同行為。
需指出傳的是甚麼，以及別人有何反應。

contrast.explanationZh: 傳開意象不確立每人永久一樣。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「你只見桌旁幾人開始接納，就能說全場往後都改了嗎？」你本來只描述附近反應。哪句澄清較準確？

options.en: I mean the welcome spread like a ripple in water among the people nearby, not that we know everyone’s later behaviour.
options.zh: 我指歡迎氣氛在附近的人間像水中漣漪傳開，不是知道所有人日後行為。

options.en: Use the few introductions as the result for every guest’s future relationships.
options.zh: 用幾次介紹當每位來賓未來關係的結果。

options.en: Leave out the later introductions because only the first gesture can count as part of the welcome.
options.zh: 只有最初舉動算歡迎，所以不提後來介紹。

dialogue.explanationZh: 具體局部傳播值得描述，既不誇成永久全體，也不漏後續反應。

speaking.en: The offer to help spread like a ripple in water, with one small act encouraging another person to join in.
speaking.zh: 幫忙提議像水中漣漪傳開，一個小行動鼓勵另一人加入。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再找出起點及向外反應。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你修改一篇故事結尾，想讓主角把多餘書送給鄰居後，鄰居再把自己的舊書留給另一人，呈現溫和的傳遞，不直接宣布整個城市從此不同。用一至兩句英文向編輯解釋想加的後續畫面。

examples.en: I would let the kindness spread like a ripple in water: after receiving a book, the neighbour leaves one of her own for someone else. That small second act would give the ending a sense of continuation.
examples.zh: 我會讓善意像水中漣漪傳開：收到書後，鄰居留一本自己的書給另一人。這第二個小行動，可讓結尾有延續感。

examples.en: The gift could spread like a ripple in water if we show the neighbour passing a different book on. I would use that visible response rather than announce a changed city.
examples.zh: 若展示鄰居再傳另一本書，禮物影響可像水中漣漪傳開。我會用那可見回應，而非宣布城市已變。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用具體第二個行動呈現影響傳遞，保留創作提議語氣，不把局部畫面誇成城市人人永久改變。

takeaways.en: Her patient explanation spread like a ripple in water as the people she helped began helping others.
takeaways.zh: 她耐心解釋後，受幫者開始幫其他人，影響像水中漣漪傳開。

takeaways.en: The invitation moved through the group like a ripple in water, reaching people beyond the first conversation.
takeaways.zh: 邀請在小組裏像水中漣漪傳開，傳到最初談話以外的人。

brief.meaningEn: Give someone a particularly welcome moment of happiness or satisfaction.
brief.meaningZh: 給某人特別受歡迎的開心或滿足時刻。
brief.grammar: make my/your/her day; made in past; possessive names the person pleased; not necessarily happiness lasting every minute
brief.boundaryZh: 形容特別受落的開心時刻，不保證當天之後每刻同樣快樂，也不是正式評定作品品質或保證長久關係。
brief.misconceptionZh: 形容特別受落的開心時刻，不保證當天之後每刻同樣快樂，也不是正式評定作品品質或保證長久關係。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「令某人當天格外開心」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Lena had spent hours making the little model, and a visitor’s careful question about its tiny doors made her day; she was delighted that someone had noticed the detail, even though she still had repairs to finish.
listening.zh: 莉娜花多時做小模型，訪客細問小門令她當天格外開心；有人留意細節令她欣喜，儘管仍有修補要做。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 她因有人真心注意自己的細節而很開心。
她很開心，因訪客主動答應接手剩餘修補，而非注意小門。
她覺得訪客問題在貶低模型，所以不快。
這一刻的喜悅保證她當天不論之後發生甚麼都保持同樣心情。

listening.explanationZh: noticed the detail 說清開心原因；未說訪客接修補，也不由 made her day 保證之後每刻同樣心情。

reply.promptEn: Why did the visitor’s question mean so much to Lena?
reply.promptZh: 訪客問題為甚麼令莉娜那麼受落？

options.en: It made her day because someone had noticed the detail she worked on.
options.zh: 有人留意她用心做的細節，令她當天格外開心。

options.en: She was delighted that the tiny doors mattered to someone else.
options.zh: 小門也令別人關注，她很欣喜。

options.en: The careful interest made her feel that her work had been seen.
options.zh: 細心興趣讓她覺得作品被看見。

options.en: It was a welcome moment after the hours she had spent on the model.
options.zh: 花多時做模型後，那是令她受落的時刻。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一位退休鄰居收到舊學生來信，具體說仍記得她某次耐心幫忙，她讀完笑得很開心；不是交代新工作。哪句貼切？

options.en: The unexpected letter made her day.
options.zh: 意外來信令她當天格外開心。

options.en: The letter guarantees that their relationship will remain close without further contact.
options.zh: 那信保證即使以後不聯絡，關係仍會一直親密。

options.en: She was disappointed because the student had forgotten the help.
options.zh: 學生忘了那次幫忙，所以她失望。

scene.explanationZh: 記得幫助的來信帶喜悅，不等於保證長久關係，也不是對方忘記。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 made her day 得出？

options.en: 她因某件受落的事很開心。
Her good mood is guaranteed to remain unchanged through everything else that happens that day.
options.zh: 無論當天之後發生甚麼，她的好心情都保證不變。

options.en: 上下文可指出令她開心的原因。

contrast.explanationZh: 習語強調某事令她很開心，不提供當天餘下每刻心情的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「那問題令她很開心，就是訪客正式確認模型達標吧？」她其實開心於細節被看見。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: It made her day to have the detail noticed; that is appreciation, not a formal assessment of the model.
options.zh: 細節被看見令她格外開心；那是受到欣賞，不是模型的正式評核。

options.en: Use the visitor’s brief question as confirmation that the model meets the exhibition’s technical standard.
options.zh: 把訪客短問題當模型符合展覽技術標準的確認。

options.en: Tell her to expect a lasting collaboration with the visitor on the strength of that one question.
options.zh: 只憑那個問題，就叫她期待與訪客有長久合作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 因細節受關注而欣喜，不等於正式評核或對長久合作作保證。

speaking.en: Your message made my day because you remembered something that mattered to me.
speaking.zh: 你記得對我重要的事，那訊息令我當天格外開心。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪件事為誰帶來喜悅。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：很久沒見的朋友傳來你們年少時共同畫畫的舊照片，連當時你為小角落加的細節也記得。你想真誠回覆照片令你很開心，再問他是否還保存其他作品，不替這次聯絡承諾日後關係。用一至兩句英文回覆。

examples.en: That photograph made my day, especially because you remembered the detail in the corner. Do you still have any of the other drawings we made together?
examples.zh: 那照片令我當天格外開心，尤其你還記得角落細節。你仍有我們一起畫的其他作品嗎？

examples.en: You made my day by sending that old photograph and remembering our drawing afternoons. I would love to hear what else you have kept from that time.
examples.zh: 你傳舊照片又記得我們畫畫的下午，令我當天格外開心。我很想聽你還保存那時甚麼。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以具體共同回憶表達受落的喜悅並自然追問，不把一則開心訊息當長久密切聯絡或整天情緒不變的保證。

takeaways.en: The note from an old friend made his day during a rather ordinary week.
takeaways.zh: 平凡一周裏，舊朋友便箋令他當天格外開心。

takeaways.en: It would make her day to hear that you still use the little notebook she gave you.
takeaways.zh: 若知道你仍用她送的小簿，她會格外開心。

brief.meaningEn: Reduce someone’s practical burden, strain or sense of having too much to carry.
brief.meaningZh: 減輕某人的實際負擔、壓力或難以獨自承擔的感受。
brief.grammar: lighten someone’s/the load; lightened/lightening; load may be tasks or felt pressure, not necessarily physical weight
brief.boundaryZh: 可以只減一部分，不等於代做全部、問題已解或對方不用選擇；需說具體怎樣有幫助。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可以只減一部分，不等於代做全部、問題已解或對方不用選擇；需說具體怎樣有幫助。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「減輕某人的負擔」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Source1736 lighten the load is the same figurative burden-reduction unit with a different determiner. Practical help and friendly words may reduce different aspects of burden; neither implies all tasks disappear.

listening.en: Taking the booking messages for one afternoon lightened her load while she prepared the exhibition; she could concentrate on the labels, although the final installation was still hers to coordinate.
listening.zh: 有人接手一下午預約訊息，減輕她籌展負擔；她可專注標籤，儘管最後布展仍由她協調。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 接手一項工作減輕負擔，其他責任仍在。
她已不需參與最後布展，整項工作被代做。
預約訊息在她做完全部標籤後才新增給她。
說話者只比較實際箱子重量，沒有工作分擔。

listening.explanationZh: 接手訊息讓她專注標籤，是局部減負，although 保留布展責任。

reply.promptEn: How did taking the messages help her?
reply.promptZh: 接手訊息怎樣幫了她？

options.en: It lightened her load by giving her time to focus on the labels.
options.zh: 它給她時間專注標籤，減輕她負擔。

options.en: One part of the preparation no longer needed her attention that afternoon.
options.zh: 那下午有一部分準備不再需她顧。

options.en: She could work on the labels without answering each booking message.
options.zh: 她可做標籤，而不用逐一答預約。

options.en: The help reduced a specific task without taking over the whole exhibition.
options.zh: 幫忙減輕一項工作，而非接管整個展覽。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生正為報告與家事兩邊忙，朋友陪他理清最擔心哪項，他說覺得沒那麼孤單、負擔輕了點；朋友未替他完成作業。哪句貼切？

options.en: The conversation helped lighten his load even though the tasks remained.
options.zh: 即使任務仍在，談話也幫他減輕負擔。

options.en: The conversation means his report was written by the friend.
options.zh: 談話表示報告已由朋友代寫。

options.en: He felt more burdened because the friend gave him a new assignment to complete.
options.zh: 朋友派新作業，令他覺負擔更大。

scene.explanationZh: 負擔感可減而工作仍在，並非代寫或新增要求。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 lighten her load 得出？

options.en: 某項幫助減輕她要承擔的負擔。
她的全部責任從此由幫忙的人接管。
需看是實際工作、情緒壓力，或兩者一部分。

contrast.explanationZh: 減負不等於全接管或無剩餘責任。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「接訊息只一下午，不算幫吧？」她因此可專心做標籤。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: It did lighten her load by covering one task; help does not have to replace every responsibility.
options.zh: 接一項工作確有減輕她負擔；幫助不必取代每項責任。

options.en: Only taking over the final installation would count; the time she gained for labels is irrelevant.
options.zh: 只有接管最後布展才算；她多了做標籤時間不相關。

options.en: Ask her to keep answering the booking messages while praising her for managing both jobs.
options.zh: 讚她兼顧兩份時，也叫她繼續答預約訊息。

dialogue.explanationZh: 具體多出專注時間已有減負，無需把全部取代才承認幫忙。

speaking.en: I can lighten your load by handling the replies this afternoon, while you decide what the project needs next.
speaking.zh: 這下午我可處理回覆減輕你的負擔，而你決定項目下一步需甚麼。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指明哪部分負擔減少。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你第一次在住戶會提出維修需要，朋友陪你去、幫你按次序放好筆記，讓你少了獨自應付的壓力；發言及最後選擇仍由你作。你想寫感謝訊息，具體說這怎減輕負擔，不把幫助說成代替你作決定。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: You lightened my load by coming to the residents’ meeting and helping me put my notes in order. Thank you for making it easier to speak while leaving the decision with me.
examples.zh: 你陪我去住戶會、幫我排好筆記，減輕我的負擔。謝謝你讓我較易發言，同時把決定留給我。

examples.en: Having you beside me helped lighten the load at my first residents’ meeting. I appreciated the quiet support without feeling that you were speaking for me.
examples.zh: 第一次住戶會有你在旁，幫我減輕負擔。我珍惜那安靜支持，而不覺得你在代我說話。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用陪伴及理好筆記具體致謝，說清壓力減輕而自主發言仍在，不把減負變代作決定。

takeaways.en: A few patient words lightened the load when he felt he had to face the whole problem alone.
takeaways.zh: 他覺需獨自面對整個問題時，幾句耐心話減輕負擔。

takeaways.en: Sharing the weekly deliveries could lighten their load without changing who made the main decisions.
takeaways.zh: 分擔每周送貨可減輕他們負擔，而不改主要決策由誰作。
