sources.sentence: One act of care made the city feel a little less cold.

brief.meaningEn: Somewhat more welcoming or humane, of a place or social experience.
brief.meaningZh: 地方或社交經驗感覺稍為更友善、有人情味。
brief.grammar: make the city/place feel a little less cold; cold describes emotional distance here; a little limits the degree
brief.boundaryZh: 不是天氣或房間溫度，也不表示一次好意使整個地方人人友善；需有主觀感受及具體關懷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是天氣或房間溫度，也不表示一次好意使整個地方人人友善；需有主觀感受及具體關懷。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「感覺沒那麼冷漠」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: When a stranger waited while I worked out the ticket machine, the unfamiliar city felt a little less cold; the small kindness made me feel welcome without changing how little I knew about the place.
listening.zh: 陌生人等我弄清售票機時，不熟的城市感覺沒那麼冷漠；小善意令我感到受歡迎，卻沒改我對地方仍很陌生。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 一次耐心關懷，令人物對陌生城市稍覺有暖意。
城市天氣因此變暖，說話者在報溫度。
說話者已熟悉整個城市所有安排。
陌生人催促離開，令說話者更不受歡迎。

listening.explanationZh: kindness、welcome 及 unfamiliar 指社交感受，a little 不等於熟悉整城。

reply.promptEn: What did the stranger’s patience change for you?
reply.promptZh: 陌生人的耐心令你有甚麼改變？

options.en: It made the city feel a little less cold while I was still finding my way.
options.zh: 我仍在摸索時，它令城市感覺沒那麼冷漠。

options.en: I felt a little more welcome in an unfamiliar place.
options.zh: 在陌生地方，我感到稍為更受歡迎。

options.en: The small kindness reduced the sense of being alone with the problem.
options.zh: 小善意減輕獨自面對問題的感覺。

options.en: It gave the moment some warmth without making me suddenly familiar with the whole city.
options.zh: 它為那刻添一點暖意，沒有令我突然熟悉整城。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 新人在討論區發問，原怕沒人理，後來一位用戶耐心回覆並指向適合的群組；新人說這地方好像沒那麼冷漠，仍需慢慢熟悉。哪句貼切？

options.en: The forum felt a little less cold after that patient reply.
options.zh: 那耐心回覆後，討論區感覺沒那麼冷漠。

options.en: She decided that the forum remained just as unwelcoming despite the patient response.
options.zh: 儘管收到耐心回覆，她認為討論區仍同樣冷漠。

options.en: She is mainly describing a change in the temperature of her computer room.
options.zh: 她主要在描述電腦房溫度改變。

scene.explanationZh: 耐心回應令新人稍覺暖意，仍需熟悉；不是感受全無改變，也不是室溫。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由此處 a little less cold 得出？

options.en: 一段社交經驗稍微更有人情味。
說話者已確立整個地方的人都很友善。
cold 的情感意思需由關懷及感受支持。

contrast.explanationZh: 局部感受不確立全體性格。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「城市沒那麼冷，是說當天氣溫升了嗎？」你談的是售票機前有人耐心等。哪句澄清較準確？

options.en: I mean it felt a little less cold socially because someone treated me with patience.
options.zh: 我指有人耐心對待我，令它在社交感受上沒那麼冷漠。

options.en: I meant the station was less confusing because I already knew every step of the journey.
options.zh: 我指自己已知旅程每一步，所以車站較不混亂。

options.en: I was comparing how quickly the new machine printed tickets with the old one.
options.zh: 我在比較新舊機器印票速度。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已給陌生人的耐心及受歡迎感，是人情暖意；不是已熟悉旅程或設備速度比較。

speaking.en: Her thoughtful reply made the unfamiliar place feel a little less cold, even though I was still learning how things worked.
speaking.zh: 她體貼回覆令陌生地方感覺沒那麼冷漠，即使我仍在學運作方式。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清人情感受與溫度。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你剛到新工作室，同伴記得你還不熟安排，主動留一份清楚便條並邀你午餐。你想寫感謝訊息，說這令陌生地方沒那麼冷漠，也期待慢慢認識大家，不誇成已經了解所有人。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Your note and lunch invitation made the new studio feel a little less cold. Thank you for remembering that I am still finding my way; I look forward to getting to know everyone gradually.
examples.zh: 你的便條及午餐邀請，令新工作室感覺沒那麼冷漠。謝謝你記得我仍在摸索；我期待慢慢認識大家。

examples.en: The studio felt a little less cold when you left that clear note and made room for me at lunch. I appreciate the welcome while I am still learning the routines.
examples.zh: 你留清楚便條、午餐為我留位時，工作室感覺沒那麼冷漠。我仍在學日常安排，很珍惜這份歡迎。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用具體關懷致謝，保留主觀一點暖意與仍在熟悉，不把地方冷暖寫成氣溫或已知人人性格。

takeaways.en: A simple welcome made the busy station feel a little less cold to the newcomer.
takeaways.zh: 一句簡單歡迎，令新人覺得忙碌車站沒那麼冷漠。

takeaways.en: The neighbourhood felt a little less cold when someone remembered her name and asked how she was settling in.
takeaways.zh: 有人記得她名字、問她適應怎樣時，鄰里感覺沒那麼冷漠。

sources.sentence: Helping does not mean saying yes to everything.

brief.meaningEn: Accept all requests or proposals within the relevant situation without distinguishing between them.
brief.meaningZh: 在相關情境把各項要求或提議全答應，沒有逐項取捨。
brief.grammar: say yes to everything; saying/said; everything is context-bound, and negative not saying yes preserves the possibility of selective help
brief.boundaryZh: 不是說選擇性拒絕就不關心，也不由一個 yes 推全部要求已答應；需交代能力與承諾範圍。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說選擇性拒絕就不關心，也不由一個 yes 推全部要求已答應；需交代能力與承諾範圍。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「答應每一個要求」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: A transparent acceptance phrase, often used in boundary-setting contexts. Not every use is critical; it is not a separate fixed idiom for all helpful behaviour.

listening.en: I wanted to help with the festival, but I was saying yes to everything before checking my evenings; by Thursday, three groups expected me at the same time, so I needed to clarify what I could actually do.
listening.zh: 我想幫文化節，但未查晚間時間就把要求全答應；到周四，三組都以為我同時會來，所以需說清實際能做甚麼。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 人物未查時間便廣泛答應，造成承諾衝突。
人物已只選一項，其他小組都清楚拒絕了。
三組要求原本分開不同晚上，沒有重疊。
人物一直拒絕全部協助，沒有承諾任何事。

listening.explanationZh: before checking、三組同時期待支持未取捨接受，需澄清，不是已選好或全拒。

reply.promptEn: Why did you need to clarify your festival commitments?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼需澄清文化節承諾？

options.en: I had been saying yes to everything without checking whether the times clashed.
options.zh: 我一直沒查時間衝突，就把要求全答應。

options.en: Several groups expected my help during the same evening slot.
options.zh: 幾組期待我在同一晚間時段幫忙。

options.en: My wish to help had led to commitments I could not all keep at once.
options.zh: 想幫忙令我作了無法同時全守的承諾。

options.en: I needed to match the offers I made with the time I actually had.
options.zh: 我需把已作的幫忙提議與實際時間配合。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 同一張海報只容許日期出現一次，一位同伴要求置頂，另一位要求只放最下；設計者未比較便先答應兩人照辦。哪句貼切？

options.en: He is saying yes to everything before comparing the conflicting design requests.
options.zh: 他未比較相互衝突的設計要求，就把它們全答應。

options.en: He has asked the two requesters to agree one date position before promising a design.
options.zh: 他承諾設計前，已請兩位要求者議定一個日期位置。

options.en: He has accepted one position and clearly declined the incompatible alternative.
options.zh: 他已接受一個位置，清楚拒絕不相容的另一個。

scene.explanationZh: 未比較就兩邊都答應，是 indiscriminate acceptance；不是已協調一處或清楚取捨。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 not saying yes to everything 得出？

options.en: 沒有把每個要求都答應。
當事人不願在任何情況提供任何幫助。
仍可能按時間及能力選擇某些幫忙。

contrast.explanationZh: 不全答應不等於全不幫。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「不全答應，就不是願意幫吧？」你想提供一項自己做得到的工作。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: I can help without saying yes to everything; let us agree the task and time I can genuinely offer.
options.zh: 我可幫而不把要求全答應；先議我真能提供的工作及時間。

options.en: Keep accepting the overlapping tasks and decide which one to miss only when Thursday arrives.
options.zh: 繼續接重疊工作，到周四才決定缺哪項。

options.en: Make no offer at all because choosing one task would be less than every group requested.
options.zh: 不作任何提議，因選一項少於每組要求。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可明確提供有限承諾，不必全接或全拒，也不拖到當日才澄清。

speaking.en: I want to help without saying yes to everything, so I need to agree a commitment I can actually keep.
speaking.zh: 我想幫而不把要求全答應，所以需議定真能守的承諾。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清選擇性承諾與全不關心。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：家人要辦回憶展，邀你拍照、設計邀請及全日接待；你只有周六早上可拍照。你想友善肯定計劃，清楚提出這一項、拒其餘兩項並請他們及早找別人，不拖到當日才說。用一至兩句英文回覆。

examples.en: I would love to help without saying yes to everything: I can take photographs on Saturday morning, but I cannot design the invitation or stay at the desk all day. Please arrange someone else for those parts.
examples.zh: 我很想幫而不把要求全答應：周六早上可拍照，但不能設計邀請或全日接待。請為那些部分另找人。

examples.en: Rather than say yes to everything and let you down later, I can offer Saturday morning for the photographs. I need to decline the invitation design and full-day reception so you have time to ask others.
examples.zh: 與其全答應後來令你失望，我可提供周六早上拍照。我需婉拒邀請設計及全日接待，好讓你有時間問別人。

glossary.en: stay at the desk all day

writing.selfCheckZh: 肯定幫忙意願，說清可做與不能做項目及時間，給對方另作安排空間，不把有限承諾當不關心。

takeaways.en: She was saying yes to everything until she compared the requests with the evenings she actually had free.
takeaways.zh: 她一直把要求全答應，直到把要求與真正有空的晚上比較。

takeaways.en: Not saying yes to everything helped him make one promise he could keep and explain it honestly.
takeaways.zh: 不把要求全答應，幫他作一個能守的承諾並誠實說明。

lessons.titleZh: 把自己當成獨力解困的英雄

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: You need not play the hero when the task is too large.

brief.meaningEn: Take on the role of the person who must rescue others or solve the difficulty, sometimes unnecessarily alone.
brief.meaningZh: 把自己放在解救別人、處理困難的角色，有時不必要地獨力承擔。
brief.grammar: do not have to/try to play the hero; played/playing; tone and context decide whether the role is admired or criticised
brief.boundaryZh: 此處提醒不需獨力全包，不否定真誠幫助或合作；也不是說人物正在演戲中英雄。
brief.misconceptionZh: 此處提醒不需獨力全包，不否定真誠幫助或合作；也不是說人物正在演戲中英雄。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「把自己當成獨力解困的英雄」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: When the deadline moved forward, Jo offered to finish everyone’s remaining pages herself, but we told her she did not have to play the hero; we could share the work and ask which parts could wait.
listening.zh: 期限提早後，喬提出獨力完成大家剩餘頁數，但我們說她不用當獨力解困的英雄；可分工，並問哪些部分可稍等。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 大家勸她不用獨力承擔，可分工及重排範圍。
大家要她退出整個項目，不再作任何貢獻。
她正在排練劇中英雄角色的台詞。
剩餘頁數已全完成，討論只在分配獎項。

listening.explanationZh: everyone’s pages herself 與 share the work 對比過度獨力承擔及合作，並非否定她所有貢獻。

reply.promptEn: Why did you tell Jo she did not have to do every page herself?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼告訴喬不用每頁都自己做？

options.en: She did not have to play the hero when we could share the remaining work.
options.zh: 大家可分剩餘工作，她不用當獨力解困的英雄。

options.en: The unfinished pages were a shared responsibility, not hers alone.
options.zh: 未完頁數是共同責任，不只她的。

options.en: We could divide the tasks and check which ones could wait.
options.zh: 我們可分工，並查哪些可稍等。

options.en: Her offer was generous, but she did not need to carry the whole response by herself.
options.zh: 她的提議很慷慨，但不需自己承擔整個回應。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一位同伴想包辦聚餐採購、佈置和清理，其他人其實已提出可分擔；你想溫和提醒不用獨力拯救整晚。哪句貼切？

options.en: You do not have to play the hero; let us agree which jobs each person can take.
options.zh: 你不用當獨力解困的英雄；我們議每人可接哪項吧。

options.en: Ask the helpers only to choose decorations while keeping all the practical jobs for yourself.
options.zh: 只請幫手選裝飾，把實際工作全留自己做。

options.en: Wait until the guests arrive before finding out which practical jobs the others could take.
options.zh: 等客人到才問其他人可接哪些實際工作。

scene.explanationZh: 已有分擔提議，現在可說清工作；不用只分裝飾選擇或等客人到才問。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由此處 do not have to play the hero 得出？

options.en: 不用把困難全放自己身上。
對方應完全不理會別人遇到的需要。
仍可給自己應付得到的幫助並與人合作。

contrast.explanationZh: 不當獨力英雄不等於不關心或不合作。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「不讓她獨力全做，是不是不珍惜她的好意？」你們是想一起負責。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: We appreciate her offer; she does not have to play the hero for her help to matter.
options.zh: 我們珍惜提議；不用當獨力英雄，她的幫助也有價值。

options.en: Accept her offer in full and wait until the deadline arrives before asking who else can help.
options.zh: 全接受她的提議，等期限到才問誰還能幫。

options.en: Keep the work entirely with her so that the team does not need to discuss its own responsibilities.
options.zh: 工作全留給她，小組就不用談自己的責任。

dialogue.explanationZh: 肯定好意也可現在分擔，不必把其他人的責任延至期限當日才談。

speaking.en: You do not have to play the hero; your contribution matters even when we share the responsibility.
speaking.zh: 你不用當獨力英雄；即使共同負責，你的貢獻仍重要。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留肯定幫助與不用全包的差別。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你是新任社團副手，見負責人為了不麻煩新人，想獨自接下一整批成員查詢。你想友善請他不用獨力當英雄，提出先讓你回兩類常見問題，再一起看不熟悉個案，不擅自答全部。用一至兩句英文提出分擔。

examples.en: You do not have to play the hero with every member’s question. Could I handle the two common categories first, then bring the unfamiliar cases to you for a discussion?
examples.zh: 每位成員的問題不用都由你獨力當英雄。我可否先處理兩類常見問題，再把不熟的個案帶來一起談？

examples.en: Please do not feel you must play the hero to spare the new helpers. I can take a clearly defined part of the replies and ask you about anything outside it.
examples.zh: 請別覺得為免麻煩新人就必須獨力當英雄。我可接清楚界定的一部分回覆，範圍以外再問你。

writing.selfCheckZh: 珍惜負責人關心新人，提出可界定的分擔及再求助方式，不把不用全包變完全退出或新人擅自全決。

takeaways.en: He tried to play the hero by accepting the whole repair project, until the group offered to divide the work.
takeaways.zh: 他想接整個修補項目當獨力英雄，直到小組提出分工。

takeaways.en: She did not need to play the hero to be helpful; one reliable contribution was welcome.
takeaways.zh: 她不用當獨力英雄也能幫忙；一項可靠貢獻已受歡迎。

sources.sentence: Her support was sincere and sustainable.

brief.meaningEn: Genuine in intention and realistic to continue over time.
brief.meaningZh: 意願真誠，而且實際上能長久維持。
brief.grammar: support/help that is sincere and sustainable; two adjectives make separate evaluations: genuine motive and workable continuity
brief.boundaryZh: 真誠不等於可無限投入；能持續也不只是口頭承諾或價格高低。此處 sustainable 指可維持，不是必談環保。
brief.misconceptionZh: 真誠不等於可無限投入；能持續也不只是口頭承諾或價格高低。此處 sustainable 指可維持，不是必談環保。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「真誠而且能持續」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Her offer was sincere and sustainable: she cared about the reading project and could reliably give one hour on her free morning each week, rather than promise daily visits she could not keep.
listening.zh: 她的提議真誠而且能持續：她關心讀書項目，每周有空的早上可可靠地給一小時，而非承諾無法維持的每日到訪。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 既有真心關注，也有實際能維持的時間範圍。
真誠表示她已答應每天來，不需查自己的時間。
她只安排這一次探訪，沒有可重複的每周時間承諾。
她不關心項目，只因被要求而勉強承諾。

listening.explanationZh: care 支持真誠，reliably one hour each week 支持可持續；不是只此一次或承諾無法維持的每日。

reply.promptEn: Why did you describe her offer as workable over time?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼說她的提議能長久維持？

options.en: It was sincere and sustainable because it matched both her concern and her actual free time.
options.zh: 它配合真心關注及實際空檔，真誠而且能持續。

options.en: She offered one hour she could reliably keep, rather than an unrealistic daily visit.
options.zh: 她提供能可靠維持的一小時，而非不切實際的每日到訪。

options.en: The commitment had a clear place in her normal week.
options.zh: 承諾在她平常一周有清楚位置。

options.en: Her care was backed by an arrangement that fitted her circumstances.
options.zh: 她的關心有配合自身處境的安排支持。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一位學生想幫鄰居整理舊相，真心有興趣，但只每月兩個下午有空；他提出那兩天並同意每月核時間，不答應隨傳隨到。哪句貼切？

options.en: He is trying to offer help that is sincere and sustainable.
options.zh: 他正嘗試提供真誠而且能持續的幫助。

options.en: Only an offer to be available at any time would show genuine concern.
options.zh: 只有答應任何時間都有空，才顯真心關注。

options.en: Reviewing the dates each month proves that he has no real interest in the photographs.
options.zh: 每月核日期證明他對相片沒有真興趣。

scene.explanationZh: 有興趣與實際可用時間可並存，核時間幫維持，不是否定真誠。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 sincere and sustainable support 得出？

options.en: 意願真誠，安排也有希望維持。
一旦是真心關注，就必定有無限時間可提供。
需分別看意願及實際可維持的範圍。

contrast.explanationZh: 真誠不創造無限時間，兩形容詞評不同層面。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「每周只一小時，心意就不夠吧？」那是她確能維持的時間。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: The offer can be sincere and sustainable without being unlimited; the reliable hour is what she can genuinely give.
options.zh: 提議不用無限也可真誠且能持續；可靠一小時是她真能給的。

options.en: Judge her concern only by whether she promises the largest possible number of hours.
options.zh: 只按她是否承諾最大時數來判關注。

options.en: Ask her to keep a daily slot she has already said she cannot manage.
options.zh: 要求她保留已說不能應付的每日時段。

dialogue.explanationZh: 以可靠可行範圍看持續，不把承諾越多當心意越真。

speaking.en: I want my help to be sincere and sustainable, so I need to offer time I can genuinely keep.
speaking.zh: 我想幫助真誠而且能持續，所以需提供真能守的時間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清真誠與可維持兩項評價。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友已連續幾月在你忙時陪你核一次投稿清單，最近說只能維持每月一次，不能臨時隨叫隨到。你想回覆感謝，肯定這種真誠又能持續的支持，答應提早約時間，不要求更多。用一至兩句英文寫訊息。

examples.en: Your support has been sincere and sustainable, and I appreciate the monthly check we can both plan for. I will ask about a date in advance rather than expect you to be free at short notice.
examples.zh: 你的支持真誠而且能持續，我珍惜大家可預先安排的每月核對。我會提早問日期，不期待你臨時都有空。

examples.en: I value help that is sincere and sustainable more than a promise you cannot keep. Thank you for the monthly check; I am happy to arrange it early and respect the time you can offer.
examples.zh: 我珍惜真誠且能持續的幫助，多於你無法守的承諾。謝謝每月核對；我願提早安排，也尊重你可給的時間。

writing.selfCheckZh: 感謝長期可安排的有限支持，尊重提早約時間及能力範圍，不用無限待命作真誠標準。

takeaways.en: Her offer was sincere and sustainable: she cared about the project and chose a regular task that fitted her week.
takeaways.zh: 她的提議真誠且能持續：她關心項目，選了一項配合每周時間的固定工作。

takeaways.en: Their support remained sincere and sustainable because they reviewed the shared task and protected a manageable commitment.
takeaways.zh: 他們檢視共同任務、保留可應付承諾，所以支持仍真誠而且能持續。

sources.sentence: I will be there for my friend after her surgery.

sources.sentence: I will be there for my friend after her surgery.

brief.meaningEn: Be available to give someone support when they need it.
brief.meaningZh: 在某人需要時，願意給予支持。
brief.grammar: be there for someone; was/has been there for; interpersonal support may be in person or from a distance, with an appropriate agreed form
brief.boundaryZh: 不要求一定同地，也不等於替對方決定、隨時無限待命或問題已解；需看對方需要甚麼支持。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要求一定同地，也不等於替對方決定、隨時無限待命或問題已解；需看對方需要甚麼支持。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「在需要時給予支持」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Although we lived in different cities, I was there for her when the application was rejected: we arranged a call, I listened to what she wanted to say, and I asked whether she wanted company or ideas.
listening.zh: 雖然我們住不同城市，申請被拒時我仍給她支持：我們約通話，我聽她想說甚麼，再問想要陪伴還是想法。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 距離不同仍可按對方需要提供聆聽及陪伴。
只有搬到同一城市，才可算支持她。
說話者已替她決定下次必須申請哪裏。
她的申請其實已獲接受，兩人只在慶祝。

listening.explanationZh: 約通話、聆聽及詢問需要是支持，不必同城，未代決定或改寫結果。

reply.promptEn: How could you support her from another city?
reply.promptZh: 住另一城市，怎樣仍可支持她？

options.en: I could be there for her through an agreed call and careful listening.
options.zh: 我可透過議好的通話及仔細聆聽，給她支持。

options.en: We made time to talk about what she actually wanted to share.
options.zh: 我們留時間談她真正想分享的事。

options.en: I asked whether she wanted company or suggestions instead of assuming.
options.zh: 我問她想要陪伴還是建議，而非假定。

options.en: The distance did not stop us arranging a form of support that suited her.
options.zh: 距離沒阻止我們安排適合她的支持方式。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 朋友第一次向家人談重要決定，請你之後留一段時間聽他感受，不要代他選；你答應晚間通話。哪句貼切？

options.en: I will be there for him afterwards, without making the decision for him.
options.zh: 之後我會支持他，不替他作決定。

options.en: The offer means I should speak to his family and choose the outcome before he does.
options.zh: 這提議表示應在他之前跟家人說，先替他選結果。

options.en: Waiting for the agreed call shows I have refused to offer support.
options.zh: 等已約好的通話，顯示我拒絕提供支持。

scene.explanationZh: 晚間聆聽是已議支持，保留朋友自主，不需代選或把約時當拒絕。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 be there for a friend 得出？

options.en: 願按需要提供支持。
已承諾不論時間與能力都必須立即處理一切。
支持可包括聆聽、陪伴或合適的實際幫忙。

contrast.explanationZh: 願支持不等於無限待命及全接管。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「你沒立即給一套答案，怎算支持？」她當時先想有人聽。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: I can be there for her by listening to what she needs before offering ideas.
options.zh: 我可先聽她需要甚麼，再提想法，來支持她。

options.en: Give her a complete plan before asking whether she wants suggestions.
options.zh: 未問是否想要建議，就先給完整計劃。

options.en: Treat her wish to talk as a request for us to make the next decision for her.
options.zh: 把她想談當作要我們代作下一決定。

dialogue.explanationZh: 支持需配合已表明的需要，不用建議或代決定取代聆聽。

speaking.en: I want to be there for you in a way that helps, so please tell me whether you need company or practical ideas.
speaking.zh: 我想用有幫助的方式支持你，所以請告訴我需要陪伴還是實際想法。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把支持與代作決定分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你剛搬進陌生大廈時，鄰居多次在你不熟時幫你找正確聯絡人，也介紹其他住戶，沒有替你決定所有事。現在你想寫感謝卡，珍惜他曾在需要時支持，並說這令你較有信心自己處理日常。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: You were there for me when I first moved into the building, helping me find contacts and meet the other residents. Thank you for giving me support without taking every decision out of my hands.
examples.zh: 我剛搬進大廈時，你給我支持，幫找聯絡人及認識其他住戶。謝謝你的幫助，而沒有把每項決定從我手上拿走。

examples.en: I am grateful that you have been there for me while I learned how things work here. Your introductions and patient guidance helped me feel ready to handle more for myself.
examples.zh: 我學習這裏怎運作時，很感謝你一直給我支持。你的介紹及耐心指引，讓我覺得能自己處理更多事。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以具體介紹及指引感謝需要時的支持，保留自主及逐漸有信心，不把支持當代作一切或要求永久待命。

takeaways.en: She was there for her friend by listening without rushing to decide what the friend should do.
takeaways.zh: 她聆聽而不急着決定朋友應怎做，給朋友支持。

takeaways.en: We can be there for them while asking which kind of help they would actually welcome.
takeaways.zh: 我們可給他們支持，同時問真正歡迎哪種幫助。

lessons.titleZh: 維持關係中合適的界限

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Caring for friends includes keeping healthy boundaries.

brief.meaningEn: Maintain reasonable limits on responsibilities, availability or personal information in relationships.
brief.meaningZh: 在關係中維持責任、可用時間或私人資料方面的合理界限。
brief.grammar: keep healthy boundaries; keeping/kept; healthy means appropriate and workable here, not a clinical measure
brief.boundaryZh: 界限不等於懲罰、冷漠或拒所有往來；需清楚說可提供甚麼、哪些需先問及尊重雙方。
brief.misconceptionZh: 界限不等於懲罰、冷漠或拒所有往來；需清楚說可提供甚麼、哪些需先問及尊重雙方。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「維持關係中合適的界限」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: A natural relationship collocation rather than a fixed whole idiom. Healthy figuratively evaluates the limits as appropriate; it does not diagnose a person or establish one universal rule.

listening.en: We kept healthy boundaries in the shared project by agreeing when replies could wait until the next day and which personal details should not be passed on without asking; we still worked closely together.
listening.zh: 共同項目中，我們議哪些回覆可等翌日、哪些私人資料傳出前需先問，維持合適界限；仍緊密合作。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 雙方議可用時間及私人資料界限，合作仍在。
維持界限表示兩人已停止一切合作。
私人資料既在項目內提過，就可轉給任何人。
只有一方定出規則，另一方的需要完全未問。

listening.explanationZh: agreeing 與 still worked closely 指協商界限與合作並存，不是全斷或任意轉資料。

reply.promptEn: What did keeping limits change in your collaboration?
reply.promptZh: 維持界限令合作有甚麼安排？

options.en: We kept healthy boundaries by agreeing reply times and asking before sharing personal details.
options.zh: 我們議回覆時間、分享私人資料前先問，維持合適界限。

options.en: Some replies could wait, and personal information needed permission before being passed on.
options.zh: 有些回覆可稍等，私人資料轉出前需許可。

options.en: We clarified what each person could expect without stopping the joint work.
options.zh: 我們說清可互相期待甚麼，沒停止合作。

options.en: The agreement gave us practical limits around time and information.
options.zh: 協議讓時間及資料有實際界限。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 同伴願每周幫你一次校稿，說請前一天傳稿、不要把他的私人聯絡方式給別人；你同意並仍保持友好。哪句貼切？

options.en: You are trying to keep healthy boundaries while continuing to help each other.
options.zh: 你們正嘗試維持合適界限，同時繼續互相幫忙。

options.en: The advance request means he has rejected every possible form of help.
options.zh: 要求提早通知，表示他拒絕任何形式幫忙。

options.en: Agreeing a proofreading slot gives permission to share his private contact details.
options.zh: 議好校稿時段，就等於可分享私人聯絡方式。

scene.explanationZh: 清楚時間及資料範圍保留幫忙，不是全拒或額外分享許可。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 keeping healthy boundaries 得出？

options.en: 維持合理責任及可用時間範圍。
只要提出界限，就不可能真心關心對方。
可同時珍惜關係及清楚交代限制。

contrast.explanationZh: 關心與合理界限可並存。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「既然一起工作，就應隨時答，也可轉彼此電話吧？」你們本來需先協商。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: We can keep healthy boundaries by agreeing availability and asking before sharing contact details.
options.zh: 我們可議可用時間、分享聯絡資料前先問，來維持合適界限。

options.en: Use the shared project as permission to pass on personal numbers without checking.
options.zh: 把共同項目當可不問便傳私人號碼的許可。

options.en: Treat a delayed non-urgent reply as the end of the working relationship.
options.zh: 把非緊急回覆稍遲，當合作關係已結束。

dialogue.explanationZh: 共同工作仍需尊重時間與資料，不用項目或回覆速度代雙方協議。

speaking.en: We can keep healthy boundaries and still care about each other by making our availability and permissions clear.
speaking.zh: 我們可說清可用時間及許可，維持合適界限而仍互相關心。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清合理界限與冷漠。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友替你畫私人回憶插圖，邀你分享成品，但不願把內裏家人故事公開。你想寫發佈前的回覆，答應先讓他看會公開哪幾張、只在獲同意後發，肯定合作而不自行解讀為全面授權。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: I want us to keep healthy boundaries around the family stories while celebrating the illustrations. I will show you the selected pictures and captions before sharing anything publicly, and wait for your agreement.
examples.zh: 我想珍惜插圖，同時為家人故事維持合適界限。公開任何內容前，我會讓你看所選圖片及圖說，並等你同意。

examples.en: We can keep healthy boundaries without hiding our appreciation of the work. Please check the proposed post first; I will only share the parts you agree can be public.
examples.zh: 我們可維持合適界限，而不用隱藏對作品的欣賞。請先核擬發內容；我只分享你同意可公開的部分。

writing.selfCheckZh: 在發佈前具體確認圖片及故事範圍，等待對方許可又肯定合作，不把可分享成品當所有私人內容已全面授權。

takeaways.en: They kept healthy boundaries by checking what could be shared outside the group.
takeaways.zh: 他們核對哪些可向組外分享，維持合適界限。

takeaways.en: Keeping healthy boundaries helped her offer a clear form of support instead of an open-ended promise.
takeaways.zh: 維持合適界限，幫她提供清楚的支持方式，而非無限承諾。
